jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - UK)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - France)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: $95K – $125K

Du übernimmst die Finanzbuchhaltung von Thorit, hands-on und eigenständig. Zusammen mit unserem CFO bist du das Finance-Team: Du buchst selbst, hältst die Zahlen sauber und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Finanzprozesse künftig aussehen.

Wir sind eine AI-Beratung. Was wir bei unseren Kunden automatisieren, wollen wir auch intern umsetzen, und die Finanzbuchhaltung bietet sich dafür besonders an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der sauber bucht und gleichzeitig Lust hat, Abläufe neu zu denken.

Heute liegt ein großer Teil der laufenden Buchhaltung noch bei unserer Steuerkanzlei. Langfristig wollen wir deutlich mehr davon selbst machen. In welchem Tempo und in welcher Reihenfolge, entscheidest du mit.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du buchst eigenständig in DATEV: Kreditoren, Debitoren, Sachkonten und Bankabstimmung

  • Du räumst Altbestände auf und hältst die offenen Posten aktuell

  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und machst daraus einen dokumentierten, wiederholbaren Prozess

  • Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen

  • Du rechnest Reisekosten ab

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Steuerkanzlei und begleitest den Jahresabschluss

  • Du schaust dir unsere Abläufe kritisch an und automatisierst, was sinnvoll ist, zum Beispiel Belegzuordnung, Abstimmungen oder Auswertungen

  • Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben, die heute noch extern laufen

  • Du dokumentierst unsere Finance-Prozesse in Confluence

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Notwendig

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der deutschen Finanzbuchhaltung, sodass du im Tagesgeschäft ohne lange Einarbeitung loslegen kannst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV

  • Solides Wissen im Handels- und Steuerrecht, soweit es die Buchhaltung betrifft

  • Du arbeitest gern eigenständig und triffst Entscheidungen, auch wenn niemand danebensteht

  • Du bist neugierig und eignest dir neue Themen schnell selbst an

  • Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung und AI und willst dich darin weiterentwickeln. Programmierkenntnisse brauchst du nicht.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für den Arbeitsalltag (unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch, ein Teil des Teams sitzt in Lissabon)

  • Du wohnst im Raum Böblingen und bist regelmäßig im Büro

Schön zu haben

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierung in der Buchhaltung, etwa Bankregeln, Belegmatching, Schnittstellen oder AI-Tools

  • Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn und Gehalt (die Abrechnung läuft aktuell extern, ist aber perspektivisch ein Thema)

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresabschlüssen zusammen mit einer externen Kanzlei

  • Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (abgeschlossen oder geplant)

UNSER SETUP

  • WeClapp als führendes System für Rechnungsausgang, Eingangsrechnungen und offene Posten

  • DATEV für die Buchhaltung und den Austausch mit der Kanzlei

  • Qonto für Kontoanbindung und Belegmatching mit DATEV-Schnittstelle

  • TravelPerk für Reisebuchungen

  • Confluence für Dokumentation, Forecast für Zeiterfassung, HubSpot als CRM

  • Claude ist bei uns Standardwerkzeug. Es ersetzt keine Buchhaltung, nimmt dir aber Recherche, Dokumentation und wiederkehrende Fleißarbeit ab.

WAS WIR DIR ZUSAGEN

  • Alle Zugriffe ab Tag 1: Bankvollmachten, System- und Leserechte

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CFO und kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung

  • Echten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Finance mit auf, statt ein fertiges System zu verwalten

  • Zeit, um Automatisierungen auszuprobieren und dich in AI weiterzubilden

RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

  • Standort: Böblingen, mindestens 2 Bürotage pro Woche

  • Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 25 Std./Woche

  • Start: ab sofort

Was wir bieten

Thorit ist die AI- und CRM-Beratung für das agentische Unternehmen. jobs.title: Senior Creative Project Manager - Brand
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

The Creative Production studio team sits squarely within our Brand function working alongside our Brand Foundations team. You will report directly to the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and join a tight-knit, highly experienced group of project management leads and producers.

In this role, you will lead our internal Creative Production studio team, the execution engine delivering all branded assets across Pleo, including campaign and performance assets, global adaptation and localization, event branding, content marketing, web, socials and lifecycle design. You will balance hands-on delivery with direct people management for a team of three in-house designers and copywriter, ensuring our creative output remains fast, scalable, and sharp across all touchpoints.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

Our Brand department is 13 people across two teams: Brand Foundations and Creative Production. You'll lead the four-person Creative Production studio, a senior copywriter, two senior designers and a motion designer, spread across our European offices. Day to day, you'll work alongside a peer project lead on Brand Foundations, a brand strategist, our producers, and internal partners in Events, Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, HR/People Ops and Legal, plus our media agency. Most of the studio's clients are internal teams across Pleo.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Creative Project Manager, you will:

Creative Production & Operations

  • Studio Ownership: Lead end-to-end execution across all creative production studio work streams, ensuring projects hit quality benchmarks, deadlines, and brand standards. This is also not just intake of brand requests but also spotting opportunities proactively for brand involvement and governance across the business.

  • Project Management: Own intake of BAU requests, filtering and assigning work while acting as the bridge between requestors and the studio team. Define scope upfront and ensure the team has what it needs to execute. Contribute to project plans for integrated campaigns and large events and manage Creative studio kick-offs, status reporting, and timeline and milestone tracking.

  • Core Output Focus: Oversee production for high-performing marketing assets, market localization and adaptations, event branding, and content marketing.

  • Process & Integration: Partner closely with peer project leads, producers, and the Brand Foundations team to streamline intake briefs, cross-team handoffs, and resource sharing.

  • Global Asset Delivery: Manage asset adaptation frameworks to keep our brand consistent across different regions and channels.

  • Capacity Planning: Own and manage resourcing across internal teams and freelance support, balancing capacity against demand and prioritizing against business needs when demands compete.

  • External agency partnerships: Serve as the lead creative point of contact for asset production with our media agency. Manage sprint-style monthly asset delivery in response to agency and internal performance team briefs, keeping output aligned with the media plan. Review final creative placements across Meta and LinkedIn to ensure assets display correctly on paid channels.

People Management & Leadership

  • Direct Management: Line manage, mentor, and foster career growth for a cross-functional team of three in-house designers and one copywriter overseeing their daily priorities and bandwidth.

Stakeholder Alignment & Strategy

  • Cross-Functional Partner: Serve as the strategic operational bridge connecting the studio with Marketing, Events, HR/People Ops, and Legal.

  • Leadership Alignment: Work closely with the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and Associate Director of Brand Management to align studio output with broader brand goals and business priorities.

We launched our new brand in September, so this is a moment to build. The studio has the basics in place, but intake, briefing, project tracking and resourcing are still early. You'll set the ways of working that the studio runs on, and we'd love you to bring AI into how we plan, brief and produce.

What you bring


You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • In-House Brand Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of work experience. Solid background working in-house in a fast-paced brand function (tech, scale-up, or high-growth environment).

  • People Leadership: Direct experience line-managing creative talent (designers/artworkers) based remotely in different offices in Europe with an empathetic, growth-oriented approach.

  • Production Scope: Broad familiarity managing workflows across digital performance, multi-market localization, physical/virtual events, AI creative production, and employer branding.

  • Culture Driver: Thrives in a peer environment working alongside other motivated and constructive senior PMs, producers, creatives, and strategists.

  • Operational Skills: Mastery of modern project management tooling and AI-powered workflows (e.g. Asana, Notion, Jira, Slack).

  • Project Management Experience: Strong hands-on project management experience in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment, running multiple projects concurrently. Comfortable not just initiating projects, but staying a consistent presence throughout: managing delivery, and reassessing priorities and capacity as needs shift.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love day-to-day production and get a kick out of turning an event brief into finished collateral within a week.

  • You want to build how a studio works, from intake to resourcing, as much as you want to ship the work.

  • You enjoy leading creatives, giving them clear briefs and keeping the work grounded in what the business needs.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You mainly want to work on big brand campaigns. We run around two a year, and they're produced with an external agency. The studio adapts those assets, but most of the work is events, performance creative and BAU requests.

  • You prefer a predictable, planned workload. Last-minute requests are part of life on Brand.

  • You haven't line-managed people yet. Direct people management of the studio team is a core part of this role.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Deliver the studio's day-to-day work to our speed and quality standards, in line with the new brand guidelines.

  • Set best practice for how the studio takes in, briefs, tracks and resources work.

  • Improve how we estimate and plan capacity, using AI where it makes sense.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the Director about the projects you've delivered, the teams you've led and the kind of production work you enjoy most.

  • Case study: You'll walk us through how you'd approach a creative production task. You'll present to the Director and a peer project lead, and possibly a member of the studio team.

  • Final stage: Team-fit chat with one or two people from the studio

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received an incredibly high volume of applications but only so many could be taken forward. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Mid-market)
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

  • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

  • Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

  • Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

  • Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

jobs.title: Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Handle large measurement datasets spanning electrical, optical, and electro-optical characterization

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

jobs.title: Brandkonsult - Stockholm
jobs.description:
Brandkonsult till Brandsäkra i Stockholm

Är du den vi söker?

Har du erfarenhet av förebyggande brandskydd, ett öga för detaljer och vill ta en nyckelroll i ett växande och engagerat team? Vi söker en engagerad och självgående Brandkonsult som vill vara med och driva det förebyggande brandskyddsarbetet framåt. Hos oss får du stor frihet under ansvar, korta beslutsvägar och möjligheten att hjälpa våra kunder att skapa trygga och säkra miljöer. Om du trivs med att kombinera kundkontakt, fältarbete och analys med eget driv - då kan det vara dig vi söker!

Om Företaget:

Brandsäkra grundades 2014 och är en helhetsleverantör inom brandskydd och systematiskt brandskyddsarbete (SBA). Vi befinner oss i en expansiv fas där vi siktar på att växa med 20 % per år och har idag cirka 10 % av marknadsandelen gällande flerbostadshus och bostadsrättsföreningar i Stockholm. Utöver Stockholm finns vi etablerade i Göteborg och planerar vidare tillväxt mot Skåne.

Totalt är vi cirka 30 anställda i bolaget, varav konsultteamet i Stockholm idag består av tre goda kollegor. Hos oss blir du en del av ett härligt och prestigelöst team som präglas av god gemenskap, korta beslutsvägar och regelbundna teamaktiviteter. Vi erbjuder konsultation, besiktningar, rapportering, förvaltning samt utbildningar och utrymningsövningar – alltid med moderna stödverktyg i ryggen.

Om tjänsten:

Som Brandkonsult på Brandsäkra tar du en central roll i vår verksamhet. Tjänsten innebär att du vägleder våra kunder, främst bostadsrättsföreningar och fastighetsägare, till rätt lösningar baserat på lagkrav och deras specifika behov.

Arbetstiden fördelas ungefär lika mellan fältarbete hos kund (cirka 50 %) och administrativt arbete med rapportskrivning (cirka 50 %). Du utgår hemifrån med tjänstebil till dina kundbesök och planerar och bokar dina dagar självständigt.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

    Genomföra kontroller, besiktningar och analyser av brandskydd i flerbostadshus i enlighet med gällande lagar och regler.
    Professionell rådgivning och stöd till kunder kring brandskydd och systematiskt brandskyddsarbete (SBA).
    Dokumentera och sammanställa ditt arbete i tydliga, välstrukturerade besiktningsrapporter och utredningar.
    Självständig planering genom att boka dina egna jobb och strukturera dina arbetsdagar effektivt.
    Kundrelationer & utveckling: Skapa och upprätthålla goda relationer med kunderna samt bidra aktivt till gruppens och verksamhetens utveckling.

Vi söker dig som:

    Har erfarenhet av förebyggande brandskydd och systematiskt brandskyddsarbete (SBA) samt ett stort och genuint intresse för området (bakgrund från t.ex. räddningstjänst, tillsyn eller fastighetsbesiktningar är meriterande).
    Är noggrann, har ett öga för detaljer och förmåga att snabbt upptäcka avvikelser och risker i fastighetsmiljöer.
    Har god analytical förmåga och kan omsätta dina observationer till välstrukturerade rapporter med tydliga slutsatser och rekommendationer.
    Trivs med självständigt arbete och tar stort ansvar för dina egna projekt och din kalender.
    Har god kommunikationsförmåga och uttrycker dig mycket väl i tal och skrift på svenska.
    Innehar giltigt B-körkort (krav).
    Är bosatt i Stockholmsområdet med omnejd.

Övrigt:

    Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidareanställning.
    Placering/Arbetssätt: Utgångspunkt hemifrån i Stockholmsområdet kombinerat med kundbesök och kontoret i Danderyd. Hybrid och flexibel arbetsmodell med tjänstebil.

Vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Fredrika Lundmark vid frågor om tjänsten på fredrika.lundmark@kraftsam.se. (fredrika.lundmark@kraftsam.se)

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Brandsäkra med Kraftsam Rekrytering och Bemanning. Externa rekryteringsbolag och säljare undanbedes vänligen men bestämt.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Butikssäljare (extrajobb), City Gross Norrköping
jobs.description:

Vårt hjärta klappar lite extra för färskvaror och vi tror på människor. Vi tror vi blir bättre när vi har olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter. Oavsett om du frontar nyskördade grönsaker, styckar en perfekt köttbit, ser till att hyllorna alltid är välfyllda eller att vi har kampanjer som passar våra kunders behov, så är alla här av en enda anledning: att skapa en grym kundupplevelse.

Om jobbet

Tjänsten avser: Timanställning vid behov

Tillträde: 2026-11-02 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetstider: Tidig morgon, sen kväll och helger förekommer som en naturlig del i arbetet.



Du sätter pricken över i:et på kundupplevelsen

Du har chans att sätta stort avtryck på våra kunders besök, därför har du ett viktigt uppdrag i att göra kundupplevelsen smidig och trevlig. Det kan innebära ett vänligt leende, en oväntad fråga eller en hjälpande inställning, så att kunden hittar rätt i butiken. Du ska se till att kunden går hem nöjd - och gärna med en extra vara i kassen och med en god känsla i kroppen!



Vad kommer du att göra?

Varje dag bjuder på nya möten och utmaningar, men några av dina huvuduppgifter är:

    Säkerställa att kunderna lämnar butiken med ett leende (och kanske en extra vara eller med ny inspiration).
    Arbeta med varupåfyllnad och skapa en trivsam butiksmiljö med ordning och reda.
    Arbeta i kassan och självscanning, inklusive serviceärenden.
    Samarbeta med kollegor i hela butiken – vi är ett lag och hjälper till där det behövs!

Vem är du?

Du är en naturlig problemlösare som gillar fart och fläkt. Ett vänligt hej och en extra hjälpande hand är en självklarhet för dig. Har du ett stort intresse för mat och att sälja varor? Super! Om du arbetat i butik tidigare– ännu bättre!



Vi tror att du:

    Har en gymnasieutbildning och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift. Eftersom våra kunder talar fler språk än så är det fantastiskt om du också gör det.
    Älskar att möta kunder och tycker att service ska vara genuin och engagerad.
    Tycker om att göra saker tillsammans och bidrar med energi och glädje.
    Är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och ser när något behöver göras och är inte rädd för att kavla upp ärmarna för att få det gjort!

Vad får du?

    Trygga villkor – Vi har kollektivavtal med Handels och Unionen.
    Prisvärd matkasse – Du får personalrabatt på allt från lyxiga helgmiddagar till snabbfixade vardagsräddare.
    Föräldraledighet med extra trygghet - vi erbjuder förstärkt föräldrapenning enligt kollektivavtal så att du kan njuta av din nya familjemedlem lite extra.
    Friskare och piggare kropp och knopp – Vi bryr oss om din hälsa och erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag, så att du kan hålla igång på det sätt som passar dig bäst.
    Karriärmöjligheter på riktigt – Hos oss finns chans att växa! Många av våra butikschefer började precis där du är nu.



Låter det som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!



Om du vill veta mer om vad tjänsten innebär, kontakta Jessica Nore, jessica.nore@citygross.se. Vi ser gärna att du vid intresse skickar din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag den 2026-10-30. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via våra jobbsidor.

jobs.title: Kreftsykepleier
jobs.description:
Vil du bidra til at innbyggerne i Horten kan få trygg og faglig god oppfølging i eget hjem – også når livet er som mest krevende?

Sykepleieenheten i Oppfølging hjemmeboende søker en engasjert og faglig sterk kreftsykepleier og/eller palliasjonssykepleier.
Stillingen gir en unik mulighet til å bidra til trygg, verdig og helhetlig oppfølging av innbyggere med alvorlig sykdom, både i tidlig fase, gjennom sykdomsforløp og ved livets slutt. Dette er en klinisk og pasientnær stilling med hovedvekt på direkte oppfølging av pasienter og pårørende i hjemmet.

Stillingen har et særskilt fokus på kreftomsorg og palliasjon, men inngår som en del av den ordinære driften i sykepleieenheten. Du vil derfor også følge opp andre pasientgrupper og bidra innen sykepleiefaglige områder som blant annet sårbehandling og avansert hjemmesykepleie.

Hos oss blir du en del av et kompetent lag sykepleiere med høy faglig kompetanse innen flere områder. Vi samarbeider tett, deler kunnskap og støtter hverandre for å sikre gode, trygge og helhetlige tjenester til innbyggerne våre.

Stillingen er en dagstilling med arbeid hver 4. helg (langvakter).

 

Vi i Oppfølging hjemmeboende arbeider for at innbyggerne skal kunne leve trygge, aktive og selvstendige liv i eget hjem. Sykepleieenheten yter avanserte sykepleietjenester til hjemmeboende og samarbeider tett med øvrige helse- og omsorgstjenester for å sikre helhetlige og koordinerte pasientforløp.

Sammen skaper vi trygge tjenester og gode hverdager for våre innbyggere.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Oppfølging av hjemmeboende pasienter med kreftsykdom og palliative behov
  • Symptomlindring, observasjon og kliniske vurderinger
  • Oppfølging og veiledning av pasienter og pårørende
  • Koordinering og samhandling med fastleger, spesialisthelsetjenesten og øvrige kommunale tjenester
  • Bidra med faglig støtte til kollegaer innen kreftomsorg og palliasjon
  • Sårbehandling og oppfølging av pasienter med behov for avansert sykepleie
  • Oppfølging av andre pasientgrupper i sykepleieenheten
  • Delta i ordinær drift og helgearbeid i enheten
Kvalifikasjoner

Krav

  • Bachelor i sykepleie og norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Videreutdanning innen kreftomsorg og/eller palliasjon
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, bestått B2, skriftlig og muntlig, eller tilsvarende
  • Ihht. helsepersonelloven § 5-4 må gyldig politiattest fremlegges før tiltredelse
  • Gyldig arbeids- og oppholdstillatelse
Personlige egenskaper
  • Faglig trygg, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Empatisk og god til å bygge tillit hos pasienter og pårørende
  • Gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsferdigheter
  •  Engasjement for kompetanseutvikling , veiledning og kunnskapsdeling

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende og meningsfull klinisk stilling med stor grad av pasientkontakt
  • Mulighet til å bruke og videreutvikle din spesialkompetanse innen kreftomsorg og palliasjon
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med høy sykepleiefaglig kompetanse
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver og stor grad av selvstendighet
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og engasjerte kollegaer
  • Tett samarbeid med kreftkoordinator

  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Horten kommune – et godt sted å arbeide, bo og leve.
Horten er en idyllisk kommune med ca 28.000 innbyggere -  vakkert beliggende og sentralt plassert på vestsiden av Oslofjorden.
Alle som bor i Horten lever nær naturen enten det er i Horten by, på Borre, Skoppum, Nykirke eller i småbyen Åsgårdstrand. Kommunen har en lang og vakker sjøfront med mange fine strender, parker og turveier. Universitetet i Sørøst-Norge ligger her og vi har mange spennende bedrifter.

Bli bedre kjent med oss her:  #Hortenlove presentasjonfilm om Horten kommune

Vi ønsker et mangfold på arbeidsplassene våre, som i størst mulig grad speiler mangfoldet i befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle - uansett etnisk bakgrunn, alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering eller religion - om å søke utlyste stillinger - dersom de er kvalifiserte.

Horten kommune følger offentlighetsloven. Det innebærer at det utarbeides offentlig søkerliste for alle stillinger. Søkere må begrunne særskilt hvis det bes om unntak fra denne. Begrunnelsen for unntaket vil bli vurdert i forhold til reglene i offentlighetsloven. Hvis det etter kommunens vurdering ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn for unntak, vil søker bli kontaktet.

 

Alle våre stillinger er å finne på våre nettsider.
Våre søkere vil alltid bli kontaktet via telefon eller fra en e-post-adresse som slutter med @horten.kommune.no.
Våre søkere vil aldri bli krevet for noen form for betaling eller kopi av ID i noe steg av en ansettelsesprosess.

Horten kommune aksepterer kun søknader sendt inn via WebCruiter

jobs.title: KOMMUNALSJEF OPPVEKST OG OPPLÆRING
jobs.description:
Som kommunalsjef er du en del av kommunedirektørens ledergruppe og øverste leder for oppvekst- og opplæringssektoren i kommunen. Stillingen innebærer blant annet ansvar for grunnskole, barnehage og Mestring og Inkludering som består av tjenestene NAV, barneverntjenesten, PPT, voksenopplæring og integreringstjenesten (VI).

 

Vi søker en leder som kan vise vei og som evner å lede omstillingsprosesser gjennom å skape tillit og bygge relasjoner, både i organisasjonen og mot lokalsamfunnet og det politiske nivået. Kommunen står overfor betydelig omstilling i årene som kommer. Evnen til ledelse i omstilling må også kombineres med evnen til å utvikle sektoren innenfor de rammebetingelsene vi har og gjennom samhandling på tvers av sektorer.

 

Du har fagansvar for hele sektoren og økonomiansvar for sektorens samlete budsjett, og personalansvar for en ledergruppe på 12 personer. Dette inkluderer rektorene, som er direkte underlagt kommunalsjef.   

 

Kvalifikasjoner:

 

- Relevant høyere utdanning

- Erfaring og kompetanse fra sektoren

- Ledererfaring fra offentlig eller privat sektor

- God kjennskap til lover og regelverk på området

- Erfaring og resultater fra omstillingsarbeid

- Erfaring og god kunnskap om budsjettprosesser og økonomistyring

- Forståelse for politisk styrte organisasjoner

- God skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne

 

Personlige egenskaper:

 

- Gode lederegenskaper

- Gode relasjons- og samarbeidsferdigheter

- Gjennomføringskraft

- Strukturert og kvalitetssøkende

 

Personlige egenskaper vektlegges.

 

Vi tilbyr:

- En selvstendig og spennende jobb

- Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø

- Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

- Medlemskap i KLP med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

- Moderne kontorlokaler og gratis parkering i Namsos sentrum

- Lønn etter avtale

 

Søknadsfrist: 8. november.

 

Har du spørsmål, kontakt Hege Svendsen i Fremo Rekruttering, tlf. 905 87 920, hege@fremogruppen.no eller kommunedirektør Sigrid Tørriseng Angen, tlf. 907 14 453, sigrid.torriseng.angen@namsos.kommune.no

 

Alle henvendelser til Fremogruppen vil bli behandlet konfidensielt, også overfor oppdragsgiver i innledende fase om ønskelig.

 

Søkere må begrunne i søknaden hvis den ønskes unntatt offentlighet. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til reglene i Offentlighetsloven § 25. Hvis det, etter kommunens vurderinger, ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn, vil søkeren bli offentliggjort. Søkerne vil i så tilfelle bli forhåndsvarslet om dette og gis da anledning til å trekke søknaden før offentliggjøring.

 

 

Namsos kommune er en IA-bedrift og opptatt av mangfold. Kommunen oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsvariasjon, nasjonalitet og etnisk bakgrunn.

 

Er dette en jobb å flytte til?

Bor du ikke i Namsos kommune, men tenker at denne jobben jammen hørtes spennende ut? Da kan du besøke oss her først – velkommen!

Velkommen til Namsos kommune (video på YouTube)

Namsos kommune på Facebook

Namsos kommunes hjemmeside

Du finner oss også på Instagram og Snap. Eller kanskje du bare like godt skal ta turen og besøke oss?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Namsos kommune ble etablert 1. januar 2020 ved sammenslåing av Fosnes, Namdalseid og Namsos kommuner - og fremstår som en moderne og robust kystkommune med gode forutsetninger for bærekraftig vekst. Kommunen ligger ved utløpet av Namsen og har gode knutepunkt mot sjø, skog og fjord. Med regionfunksjoner og et aktivt handels-, kultur- og tjenestesenter, er Namsos både en regional motor og har gode lokalsamfunn å leve i.

jobs.title: Handläggare – bidra i utvecklingen av transportsystemet
jobs.description:
Enheten för utveckling och styrning av transportområdet, Landsbygds- och infrastrukturdepartementet

Vill du vara med och stödja regeringens arbete att utveckla Sveriges transportsystem? Tycker du det är spännande att följa och förstå hur transportsektorn möter viktiga utmaningar? Vi söker nu en driven och analytisk handläggare som kan bidra i arbetet med frågor som spänner över alla trafikslag och aktuella utvecklingsområden.

Din arbetsdag, Sveriges morgondag

Enheten för utveckling och styrning av transportområdet består av 13 medarbetare. Enheten är en av tre enheter inom transportområdet och ansvarar för frågor som rör den långsiktiga strategiska utvecklingen av transportområdet och för myndighetsstyrning avseende Trafikverket, Statens väg- och transportforskningsinstitut, Sjöfartsverket, Luftfartsverket och Transportstyrelsen samt Trafikanalys.

Utifrån regeringens prioriteringar tar du fram beslutsunderlag i frågor som berör väg, järnväg, sjöfart och luftfart. Det kan exempelvis handla om transportsektorns klimatomställning, kompetensförsörjning, utveckling och uppföljning av Sveriges transportpolitiska mål samt andra strategiskt viktiga frågor för transportsystemets utveckling. En central del i arbetet på enheten är att du självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor tar fram kvalificerade analyser och policyrelevanta underlag som kan ligga till grund för att utveckla regeringens politik.

Som handläggare kommer du att:

    Ansvara för en eller flera aktuella frågor som rör transportsektorns utveckling.
    Stötta i arbetet att hålla samman departementets i arbete med den nya Myndigheten för tillväxt- och transportanalys.
    Hålla samman arbetet med transportstatistik.

Som handläggare på enheten för utveckling och styrning av transportområdet kommer du också att ta fram underlag till statsrådens svar på frågor och interpellationer från riksdagen samt underlag till den politiska ledningens anföranden och möten.

Läs mer om vår verksamhet på https://www.regeringen.se/sveriges-regering/landsbygds--och-infrastrukturdepartementet/landsbygds--och-infrastrukturdepartementets-organisation/

Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har:

    Relevant akademisk examen.
    Flerårig och aktuell erfarenhet av relevant och kvalificerat utrednings- eller utvecklingsarbete vid statlig myndighet eller motsvarande organisation.
    Erfarenhet av arbete inom transportområdet eller angränsande politikområden.
    Mycket goda kunskaper att uttrycka sig på svenska i tal och skrift.
    Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av arbete inom Regeringskansliet.
    Erfarenhet av arbete som rör samhällets klimatomställning.
    Erfarenhet av utredningar som handlat om effektivitet och måluppfyllelse i offentlig förvaltning.
    Kunskaper i utredningsmetodik och statistiska metoder.
    Kunskap eller kännedom om Regeringskansliets arbets- och samrådsformer.
    Kunskap om EU:s samrådsformer och institutioner.
    Goda kunskaper i offentlig förvaltning.

Dina egenskaper

Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling, resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.

För den här tjänsten behöver du ha lätt för att samarbeta med personer i olika roller och funktioner och ha förmågan att snabbt anpassa dig till ändrade förhållande och kunna sätta dig in i nya sakfrågor. Arbetet förutsätter vidare att du har en mycket god förmåga att på ett effektivt sätt kunna analysera och värdera komplexa samband och ta fram underlag utifrån verksamhetens behov. Vi ser även att du har mycket god förmåga att på ett pedagogiskt och lättillgängligt sätt kunna förklara och kommunicera slutsatser, konsekvenser och handlingsalternativ till politiska ledningen och kollegor. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Läs mer på https://www.regeringen.se/jobba-hos-oss/att-arbeta-i-regeringskansliet/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap-i-regeringskansliet/

Övrigt

Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med 6 månaders provanställning.

En säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.

I samband med din ansökan får du besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor. Vi ber dig att ta dig tid att besvara dessa noggrant, då de ligger till grund för vårt fortsatta urval.

Är du intresserad?

Vill du veta mer om jobbet och vad vi erbjuder, kontakta enhetschef Claes Elmgren eller rekryteringsspecialist Sophie Karlsson, mailto:sophie.karlsson@regeringskansliet.se. Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Lars Arell för Saco och Ivian Paulino Lorenzo för ST. Du når samtliga via Regeringskansliets växel, 08-405 10 00. Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast den 8 november 2026.



Regeringskansliets uppdrag är att stödja regeringen i dess arbete med att styra Sverige och förverkliga sin politik. Här arbetar 4 800 personer, varav 600 utomlands. Regeringskansliet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi ser jämställdhet och mångfald som en styrka och tillgång och vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering. Landsbygds- och infrastrukturdepartementet ansvarar för frågor som rör landsbygd, livsmedel och areella näringar, regional utveckling, transporter och infrastruktur samt bostäder och samhällsplanering.
