jobs.title: Director Product Management - Identity & Activation
jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

The role

We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. You will own product strategy and roadmap across both identity and activation, bring a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and turn that into products customers want to buy.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate at two altitudes. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. You will play a meaningful part in expanding our client base, which means you understand the market, the buyers, and what it takes to win them.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for identity resolution and activation, and make the prioritization calls that keep the team focused on what matters most.

  • Advance our identity resolution product: graph building and enrichment, cross-device and cross-identifier linking, and interoperability.

  • Own the activation side with equal weight: audience activation, data orchestration, and delivery across a broad and growing set of destinations, including platforms and DSPs, in cloud-native environments.

  • Develop a clear understanding of the market and competitive landscape, and translate it into product positioning and roadmap decisions that expand the client base.

  • Partner directly with customers and commercial teams to understand what they need, and translate commercial requirements into clear, buildable specifications for engineering.

  • Work hands-on with engineering day to day to deliver, unblock decisions quickly, and keep the roadmap moving.

  • Own privacy and data governance considerations across the product, so that identity and activation are built to a privacy-first standard from the start.

  • Define the success metrics for the products you own, and use them to guide investment and iteration.


Who You Are:

 

  • Significant product management experience in AdTech, MarTech, or B2B data platforms, with a track record of owning products end to end.

  • Deep domain expertise in identity resolution and device/identity graphs: how graphs are built, enriched, maintained, and measured.

  • Strong experience in the activation and data movement domain: audience activation, destination integrations, and cloud-native or composable data architectures.

  • A clear, informed point of view on where the identity and activation market is heading, and the commercial judgment to know which customers and use cases to build for.

  • A demonstrated record of helping expand a product's customer base, ideally with platforms, DSPs, media networks, or similar AdTech customers.

  • Proven ability to work directly with customers and commercial teams and translate their requirements into specifications engineering can build against without a long back-and-forth.

  • Hands-on delivery experience: writing specs, prioritizing ruthlessly, and shipping alongside engineering in a fast-moving environment.

  • Comfort setting direction and operating with ambiguity in an early-stage environment.

  • Working knowledge of the privacy and consent landscape and how it shapes data products.

  • Curiosity about how AI is changing product configuration, data discovery, and activation workflows.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python
  • Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets
  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

  • Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

What you'll do
  • Under the supervision of the Business Automation team’s more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.
    •  
    Automation Development:
  • Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes
  • Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods
  • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects
    •  
    Data Integration & Transformation:
  • Support the implementation of data pipelines that integrate data from various sources, including APIs, external databases, and third-party services
  • Assist in transforming raw data into clean and ready-to-use models using SQL and dbt
  • Collaborate on data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives
    •  
    Monitoring and Support:
  • Help implement monitoring for automation workflows and data pipelines
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions
  • Assist in documentation of systems, processes, and workflows
    •  
    Collaboration & Learning:
  • Work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders - as diverse as HR, Sales and Product Engineering - to understand requirements and implement effective solutions
  • Continuously expand knowledge of data engineering and automation best practices
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

    • Who you are

  • Technical skills

    The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role.

  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g. layered or dimensional models)
  • Solid coding skills in Python
  • Understanding of ELT/ETL patterns, pipeline design, and data quality testing
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and CI/CD concepts
  • Practical experience with a public cloud provider and a cloud data warehouse
  • Attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify edge cases
  • Good understanding of AI and LLM principles, along with practical use of AI tools in your work
  • Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and verbal

    • Soft skills

  • Problem-solving mindset with critical thinking about business processes
  • Strong communication abilities - translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and active listening skills for accurately capturing business requirements
  • A natural curiosity, eagerness to learn, and comfort asking questions early rather than staying blocked are an absolute must
  • Bonus points: Basic project management capabilities - tracking tasks, managing timelines, and reporting progress

    • Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt, Airflow, or Terraform
  • Exposure to ingestion and reverse ETL tools
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered pipelines or applications

    • What we offer
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in Switzerland.

As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews.
  • Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed.
  • Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities.
  • Prepare German VAT filings, including Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung and Zusammenfassende Meldung, and support payroll tax declarations (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung) in collaboration with external payroll providers and tax advisors.
  • Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with German Commercial Code (HGB) requirements, as well as statutory audits and tax filings.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and compliance practices.
  • Review and improve existing accounting processes, resolve outstanding items, clean up historical ledger discrepancies, and establish more efficient financial workflows.
  • Prepare financial KPIs and management reports, validating data accuracy and consistency before submission.
  • Support monthly variance analysis by comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, investigating discrepancies, and providing relevant insights.
  • Collaborate with the wider finance team on daily accounting operations, reporting activities, process improvements, and special projects.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of professional accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for German accounting practices under HGB and German tax requirements.
  • Experience in the software, technology, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry.
  • Solid understanding of accrual accounting, financial reconciliations, journal entries, closing procedures, and financial reporting.
  • Practical knowledge of German VAT requirements and familiarity with payroll tax declarations and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and accounting reports.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting and enterprise resource planning systems is an advantage.
  • Experience managing multiple legal entities or multi-currency accounting is a plus.
  • A professional qualification in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and reliability, with a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial documentation and reporting.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to resolve historical accounting issues, organize incomplete records, and improve existing processes.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities in a fully remote environment.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate proactively with colleagues, external advisors, and service providers across remote teams.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new systems, expand responsibilities, and develop professionally over time.
  • Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken.
  • Residence in Europe and legal authorization to work in the country of residence. Being based in or near Berlin is an advantage.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement: Work remotely from an eligible location within Europe.
  • International working environment: Collaborate with finance professionals and stakeholders across an international software group.
  • Entrepreneurial team culture: Benefit from a hands-on environment that encourages ownership, initiative, and practical problem-solving.
  • Professional development: Expand your accounting expertise and gain exposure to international financial operations, reporting, and process improvement.
  • Meaningful responsibilities: Take ownership of day-to-day accounting activities and contribute directly to the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations.
  • Career growth opportunities: Develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities as you gain experience.

Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.

Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.title: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.title: Shift Manager
jobs.description:
Teamleader Restaurant - Een uitdagende rol in een dynamisch restaurant in jouw regio, met een voltijdse functie.

Ben jij een natuurlijke leider die graag het team naar succes leidt? Heb je een passie voor de horeca en wil je bijdragen aan een uitstekende klantbeleving? Wil je deel uitmaken van een enthousiast team?

  • Heb je ervaring in de horeca of management?
  • Ben je bereid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor de operationele gang van zaken?
  • Kun je goed samenwerken en communiceren met je team?

Als Teamleader Restaurant ben jij de rechterhand van de restaurantmanager en verantwoordelijk voor het vlotte verloop van het restaurant. Je stelt dagelijkse doelen voor je team en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen betrokken is bij het succes. Je beheert planningen en voorraden, ondersteunt je teamleden en zorgt voor een uitstekende service aan de klanten. Dankzij jouw scherpe inzicht in de verwachtingen van klanten en jouw sterke teamgevoel, zorg je voor een hoge klanttevredenheid.

Om succesvol te zijn in deze rol, zijn er een aantal vereisten waar je aan moet voldoen. We zoeken iemand die dynamisch en positief is, met ervaring in de horeca en/of management. Je blinkt uit in zelfstandigheid en aanpassingsvermogen.

  • Ervaring in de horeca of management is een must.
  • Je hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Je bent een teamspeler met leiderschapskwaliteiten.
  • Je hebt een scherp inzicht in klantverwachtingen.

Bij TRIXXO Jobs kijken we verder dan alleen een cv. We zoeken naar de mens achter de kandidaat, naar de passie in het vakmanschap en naar die ene match die voor beide partijen het verschil maakt. Of je nu een starter bent die zijn eerste stappen zet of een ervaren professional op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging: wij geloven dat werkgeluk begint bij een persoonlijke aanpak. Heb je interesse? Solliciteer direct via onze website!

jobs.title: Operational Manager
jobs.description:
Ben jij een geboren leider met een passie voor horeca, entertainment en gastvrijheid? Krijg jij energie van een dynamische omgeving waarin geen enkele dag hetzelfde is? Dan is de functie van Operational Manager misschien wel iets voor jou!


Als Operational Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operationele werking van onze locatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat alle afdelingen vlot samenwerken, de medewerkers goed aangestuurd worden en onze FANS telkens opnieuw een geweldige ervaring beleven.


Je combineert sterke organisatorische en leidinggevende skills met een hands-on mentaliteit en een grote focus op service en kwaliteit.


Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het dagelijkse reilen en zeilen van het restaurant en onze activiteiten, zoals bowling, karaoke, pool, arcade, darts, shuffle en meer.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat alle afdelingen efficiënt en volgens de afgesproken kwaliteitsstandaarden functioneren.
  • Je bewaakt de operationele en financiële targets en stuurt bij waar nodig.
  • Je coacht, motiveert en begeleidt medewerkers en zorgt voor een sterk en betrokken team.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega's en rapporteert wekelijks aan het management.
  • Je organiseert en coördineert speciale evenementen, groepsreservaties en andere activiteiten.
  • Je bewaakt de interne organisatie, veiligheid en kwaliteit binnen zowel de keuken als de zaal.
  • Je volgt bestellingen, leveringen en het voorraadbeheer op.
  • Je ziet toe op een correcte toepassing van de hygiëne-, veiligheids- en bedrijfsvoorschriften.
  • Je signaleert problemen en neemt initiatief om snel tot praktische oplossingen te komen.
  • Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer en springt bij waar nodig om een optimale service te garanderen.
  • Je draagt actief bij aan een positieve werksfeer en een uitstekende beleving voor onze gasten

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige managementfunctie binnen de horeca.
  • Je bent een natuurlijke leider die mensen kan motiveren, coachen en enthousiasmeren.
  • Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische en leidinggevende vaardigheden.
  • Je communiceert vlot en professioneel, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je bent klantgericht en hebt een sterke passie voor hospitality en gastbeleving.
  • Je bent stressbestendig en behoudt het overzicht, ook tijdens drukke momenten.
  • Je bent sterk in probleemoplossend denken en durft beslissingen te nemen.
  • Je bent flexibel en kunt je gemakkelijk aanpassen aan een dynamische werkomgeving.
  • Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit en bent niet bang om zelf de handen uit de mouwen te steken.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en streeft naar kwaliteit in alles wat je doet.
  • Je bent bereid om flexibel te werken, inclusief avonden, weekends en feestdagen.

Jij vindt werkgeluk in:

  • Het actief bijdragen aan de teamdynamiek en samenwerking;
  • Een flexibel uurrooster waarbij je bereid bent om ook in het weekend te werken.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in de volgende vereisten:

  • Je verwelkomt onze klanten altijd met een glimlach.

jobs.description:
Facharzt / Fachärztin für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (Hausarzt) 80-100% in Cazis gesucht.
Deine Fachkompetenz für eine ganzheitliche Patientenbetreuung!

Cazis liegt im Prättigau im östlichen Kanton Graubünden und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage in einer attraktiven Alpenregion. Die Gemeinde verfügt über gute Verkehrsanbindungen durch die Bahnlinie Prättigau und ist zentral positioniert für Pendler. Sie profitieren von einem vielfältigen Arbeitsmarkt in Tourismus, Handwerk und kleineren Industriebetrieben, kombiniert mit hoher Lebensqualität und direktem Zugang zur Natur.

**Einsatzort:** Cazis und Umgebung
**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Die hausärztliche Versorgung ist eine der wichtigsten Säulen des Gesundheitssystems. Du bist **Facharzt / Fachärztin für Allgemeine Innere Medizin** und suchst eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit direktem Patientenkontakt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Unser **Personalbüro für Pflege in Cazis** vermittelt qualifizierte Fachkräfte in **offene Stellen für Ärzte in Cazis**, insbesondere in Hausarztpraxen, Gruppenpraxen und Gesundheitszentren.

### Deine Aufgaben – Ganzheitliche Betreuung mit medizinischer Expertise

- Selbstständige Durchführung hausärztlicher Konsultationen, Diagnostik und Behandlungen

- Betreuung und Begleitung von Patienten mit akuten und chronischen Erkrankungen

- Präventivmedizin, Gesundheitsberatung und Impfmanagement

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachspezialisten zur interdisziplinären Behandlung von Patienten

- Dokumentation und digitale Erfassung von Patientendaten sowie Umsetzung von Qualitätsstandards

- Hausbesuche und Betreuung von Patienten in Pflegeeinrichtungen (je nach Bedarf)

### Dein Profil – Medizinische Kompetenz mit Empathie

- Abgeschlossenes Medizinstudium mit Facharzttitel **Allgemeine Innere Medizin (FMH oder äquivalente Anerkennung)**

- Berufserfahrung in der hausärztlichen Versorgung oder in einer allgemeinmedizinischen Praxis von Vorteil

- Freude an der Arbeit mit Patienten in verschiedenen Lebenssituationen

- Teamfähigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und eine patientenorientierte Arbeitsweise

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil

### Unser Angebot – Deine Zukunft in der Hausarztmedizin

- **Attraktive offene Stellen für Ärzte in Cazis 80-100%** in modernen Praxen oder Gesundheitszentren

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Festanstellung oder selbstständige Tätigkeit in einer Praxisgemeinschaft

- Individuelle Karriereberatung durch unser **Personalbüro für Pflege in Cazis**, um die optimale Position für dich zu finden

- Unterstützung bei administrativen Prozessen wie Anerkennung von Diplomen und Arbeitsbewilligungen

- Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote im Bereich Hausarztmedizin, Präventivmedizin und Praxismanagement

- Moderne Infrastruktur, digitale Praxisverwaltung und ein eingespieltes Team

Produktionsleiter\*in Landwirtschaft 80\-100%
=============================================

Hier wird produziert! Auf dem Spargelhof werden Kürbisse, Spargeln, Erdbeeren und weitere 5 Nebenkulturen produziert. Wir verfolgen hierbei den Weg der regenerativen Landwirtschaft. Hast du Lust, mit uns die Erfolgsgeschichte des Spargelhof Rafz weiterzuschreiben? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Unsere landwirtschaftliche Produktionsteam besteht aus 30\-80 Personen, je nach Saison. Ein grosser Teil der Belegschaft sind Saisonkräfte, überwiegend aus Polen, Rumänien und Ungarn. In der Führung dieser Abteilung suchen wir deshalb eine\*n Produktionsleiter\*in.  

**Du möchtest wissen, wie wir auf dem Spargelhof Rafz Landwirtschaft arbeiten und wohin wir uns entwickeln? Dann wirf einen Blick hinter die Kulissen und erfahre im**  **mehr über die spannende als Produktionsleiter\*in Landwirtschaft.**

Was dich erwartet
-----------------

Als Produktionsleiter\*in übernimmst du gemeinsam mit dem Führungsteam der Produktion die operative Leitung unserer landwirtschaftlichen Produktion, von der Saisonplanung bis zur Umsetzung auf dem Feld. Dein Fokus wird auf den Bereichen Gemüse \& Ackerkulturen, von Saatgut, Düngung und Pflanzenschutz über Fruchtfolge, Anbaustrategie, Bewässerung und Ernte bis hin zum Betriebsmitteleinkauf liegen. Du planst den Personaleinsatz, führst das Team direkt im Feld und sorgst für effiziente Abläufe. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du unsere Produktion mit Blick auf regenerative Landwirtschaft, Wirtschaftlichkeit und laufende Effizienzsteigerung weiter. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf unseren Hauptkulturen Kürbis und Spargel. Gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen im Produktionsteam und der Hofleitung entwickelst du diese Kulturen laufend weiter. Die Evaluation neuer Sorten, die Optimierung der Anbaumethoden sowie die Weiterentwicklung von Mechanisierung und Lagerung bilden dabei zentrale Eckpfeiler.

Was du mitbringst
-----------------

Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gemüsegärtner\*in EFZ oder eine vergleichbare landwirtschaftliche Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Landwirt\*in EFZ, und bringst bereits Erfahrung in der landwirtschaftlichen Produktion mit. Kenntnisse im Gemüsebau, insbesondere im Anbau von Kürbis oder Spargel, sind von Vorteil. Du hast Freude daran, Menschen zu führen, zu fördern und zu motivieren und bist mit der Führung von Mitarbeitenden aus unterschiedlichen kulturellen Hintergründen vertraut. Organisationstalent, Kommunikationsstärke und unternehmerisches Denken zeichnen dich aus. Du hast Lust, Prozesse laufend zu verbessern, Daten zu analysieren und moderne Arbeitsmethoden einzubringen. Deine Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind sehr gut, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Du kannst mit anpacken und bist während den Saisonspitzen belastbar.

Was du erwarten kannst
----------------------

Bei uns kannst du Verantwortung übernehmen, dich weiterentwickeln, eine bodenständige Unternehmenskultur mit echtem Teamgeist erleben. Du wirst gefordert und gefördert, darfst dich aktiv in die Unternehmensentwicklung einbringen. Wir bieten attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen mit diversen Benefits. Darüber hinaus findest du bei der Farm AG einen Arbeitgeber, bei der Nachhaltigkeit zur Unternehmens DNA gehört.

Mit Leidenschaft fängt bei der BMW Group alles an. Sie macht aus einem Beruf eine Berufung \- und aus Ideen Innovationen, die Mobilität immer wieder neu definieren.

Contrôleur qualité
====================

Chez Protylux SA, PME industrielle active dans l’injection plastique pour l’industrie horlogère, nous plaçons la qualité, la rigueur et la maîtrise des processus au cœur de nos activités.

 

Dans le cadre de notre activité, nous recherchons un

 

**Contrôleur Qualité (H/F)** pour renforcer notre équipe

**Vous avez le sens du détail, aimez le travail précis et accordez une grande importance à la qualité ? Rejoignez notre équipe !**

 

**Vos missions**

**Contrôle des pièces :** réaliser les contrôles visuels, dimensionnels et fonctionnels conformément aux plans, spécifications et instructions de contrôle.

**Contrôles qualité :** effectuer les contrôles à réception, en cours de production et avant la libération des produits.

**Utilisation des moyens de mesure :**effectuer les mesures à l’aide d’instruments adaptés, tels que pied à coulisse, micromètre, comparateur, balance et appareils de contrôle spécifiques.

**Suivi des équipements de mesure :**participer à leur identification, à leur vérification et à leur suivi métrologique, ainsi qu’à la tenue des enregistrements associés.

**Gestion des non\-conformités :**identifier et isoler les produits non conformes, documenter les écarts et participer à leur traitement.

**Documentation et traçabilité :**renseigner les rapports de contrôle et garantir l’enregistrement fiable des résultats.

**Contrôle des dossiers de lot :**vérifier la présence, la conformité et la cohérence des documents et enregistrements requis avant validation et libération.

**Gestion des pièces de référence :**assurer leur identification, leur suivi et leur archivage.

**Amélioration continue :** participer au suivi des actions correctives et contribuer à l’amélioration des processus qualité.

**Documentation qualité :** participer à la mise à jour des formulaires, instructions de contrôle et autres documents qualité.

 

**Profil recherché**

Formation technique ou expérience dans le contrôle qualité, la métrologie ou un domaine industriel similaire.

Formation TQ1 en contrôle qualité, un atout.

Bonne capacité de lecture et d’interprétation de plans techniques et de spécifications.

Connaissance des instruments de mesure et des méthodes de contrôle dimensionnel.

Aisance avec les outils informatiques et la gestion documentaire.

Personne rigoureuse, méthodique, précise et dotée d’un bon esprit d’analyse.

Sens des responsabilités et capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant avec la production.

Bonnes connaissances du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

 

**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Un poste varié avec des responsabilités concrètes dans le domaine de la qualité.Un environnement de travail dynamique au sein d’une entreprise à taille équipe engagée où la qualité et la précision occupent une place possibilité de développer ses compétences et de contribuer activement à l’amélioration continue de l’entreprise.

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.

**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

Global Head of Regulatory Strategy
==================================

**The Opportunity**


NonStop Consulting is partnering with an established international pharmaceutical organisation to appoint a Global Head of Regulatory Strategy.

This is a high\-impact senior leadership opportunity for an accomplished Regulatory Affairs executive to shape and drive global regulatory strategy across an international pharmaceutical portfolio.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in defining regulatory direction, influencing critical development and commercial decisions, and ensuring the successful execution of regulatory strategies across key international markets.

In this senior leadership position, you will combine strategic oversight with hands\-on leadership, guiding an experienced international team and collaborating closely with key cross\-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Global Regulatory Strategy: Define, lead and execute comprehensive regulatory strategies across multiple assets, from clinical development through registration, commercialisation and lifecycle management.
* Strategic Leadership: Provide senior\-level regulatory guidance to global development teams, ensuring regulatory considerations are embedded in key portfolio and business decisions.
* Regulatory Authority Engagement: Oversee high\-level interactions and negotiations with major international health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, PMDA and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Global Team Leadership: Lead, develop and mentor an international team of senior regulatory professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance.
* Portfolio Oversight: Direct regulatory strategy and execution across key markets, including the US, Europe and selected international territories.
* Executive Collaboration: Contribute to global regulatory leadership decisions, resource allocation, risk management and long\-term functional strategy.
* Business Development Support: Provide strategic regulatory input into due diligence activities, potential licensing opportunities and portfolio assessments.
* Operational Excellence: continuous improvement, innovation and the responsible adoption of new technologies to enhance regulatory effectiveness.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Quality, Commercial and other global functions to support business objectives.


**Your Profile**
----------------


We are seeking an experienced, commercially aware and strategically minded Regulatory Affairs leader with the credibility to operate at the highest levels of an international pharmaceutical organisation.


**Essential experience and qualification**s:

* Extensive experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Significant leadership and organisational management experience, ideally within an international regulatory function.
* Proven experience defining and delivering global regulatory strategies across complex pharmaceutical portfolios.
* Extensive experience engaging with major regulatory authorities, particularly the FDA and EMA, with broader international regulatory exposure.
* Strong understanding of global drug development, registration, commercialisation and product lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead and develop international teams, including senior regulatory leaders.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills, with experience contributing to executive\-level decision\-making.
* Strong strategic judgement, regulatory risk management capabilities and the ability to navigate complex development challenges.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; PharmD, PhD or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
* Fluency in English.
* Experience with specialised therapies, complex development programmes or niche therapeutic areas would be advantageous


Why Consider This Opportunity?
------------------------------

* Executive\-level influence: Play a key role in shaping global regulatory strategy and contributing to high\-level business decisions.
* International scope: Take ownership of regulatory strategy across multiple markets and a diverse pharmaceutical portfolio.
* Leadership impact: Lead and develop an established team of experienced regulatory professionals.
* Strategic visibility: Work closely with senior leadership and influence the direction of a global regulatory function.
* Innovation and transformation: Drive continuous improvement and contribute to the evolution of regulatory strategy and operational excellence.
* Meaningful impact: Support the development and successful commercialisation of innovative therapies for patients worldwide.

* Rédiger la correspondance, scanner et classer les documents selon les règles internes (et parfois, selon ton instinct, car ici le mot d’ordre c’est « adapter » et non « adopter ») ;
* Participer à l’administration de nos PPE en assistant l’administrateur/trice, dans le but de varier les plaisirs et d’entretenir ta polyvalence, en ajoutant un petit challenge ;
* Être le point de contact de tout ce petit monde : locataires, concierges, maîtres d’état, copropriétaires et propriétaires — conforter les positions de nos clients, instaurer la paix dans les relations, enfin, sécuriser le portefeuille.

As a systems research institute, FiBL has stood for interdisciplinary excellence, close collaboration with practitioners and a comprehensive knowledge exchange across the value chain for over 50 years – in dialogue with civil society and policymakers.

Internship in Department of Crop Sciences – Focus on Insects in Agroecosystems (Plant Protection group) (100%)

Do you like lab as well as field experiments? Are you curious about insects and would love to work with them? Do you have a keen interest in organic farming? If you said yes 3 times this opportunity might be for you!

jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Neerach sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Bezugspflege.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Neerach

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Bezugspflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Neerach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Neerach liegt in der reizvollen Landschaft des Zürcher Unterlands und bietet Ihnen eine ausgezeichnete Erreichbarkeit durch die Nähe zu wichtigen Verkehrsachsen. Die Region besticht durch ihre idyllische ländliche Umgebung mit guter Infrastruktur und schnellen Verbindungen in die Wirtschaftszentren. Sie profitieren hier von der perfekten Balance zwischen ländlicher Lebensqualität und beruflichen Chancen in der dynamischen Zürcher Region.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Neerach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Bezugspflege

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Neerach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

In der Region Neerach im Kanton Zürich besteht eine kontinuierlich hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen, da die alternde Bevölkerung und der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen auch hier spürbar sind. Sie finden als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH mit einer Anstellung in Bezugspflege zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent ausgezeichnete Chancen bei lokalen Spitälern, Pflegezentren und ambulanten Diensten. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen als spezialisierter Vermittler den Einstieg erheblich, da wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern in Ihrer Region verbinden und den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess professionell begleiten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Neerach

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Neerach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Neerach wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.
- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Neerach. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

**Per E-Mail:** nk@med-ipersonal.ch

The British Embassy in Berne is part of a world\-wide network representing British political, economic and consular interests. We are recruiting a Corporate Services Intern.



Corporate Services Intern
=========================







The British Government is an inclusive and diversity\-friendly employer. We value difference, promote equality and challenge discrimination, enhancing our organisational capability. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, race, colour, ethnicity, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, age, veteran status or other category protected by law. We promote family\-friendly flexible working opportunities, where operational and security needs allow. The FCDO operates an agile workforce and to facilitate this, you may be required to undertake other duties from time to time, as we may reasonably require.









**Main purpose of job:**





The Corporate Services Intern at the British Embassy in Berne provides hands\-on office management and administrative support to the Corporate Services team, with a particular focus on invoice processing, financial administration systems, and general office administration. The role is central to processing supplier invoices and payments, maintaining ERP and financial systems and trackers, and supporting procurement\-to\-pay processes, HR administration, logistics for arrivals and departures, and inventory management. The internship offers a practical grounding in business administration and office management, and is best suited to candidates with a genuine interest in finance, systems and administrative processes.



**Roles and responsibilities:**



* Process supplier and contractor invoices end\-to\-end, including checking accuracy against purchase orders/contracts, entering and tracking payments on internal finance systems, resolving queries, ensuring payments are made accurately and on time, and resolving issues with payment processes or records.
* Act as first point of contact for office administration, HR and finance queries; log and redirect requests using internal tracking systems; signpost to guidance and escalate where needed.
* Information management for Corporate Services, including internal management systems and online guidance, sharing and maintaining information on local Sharepoint pages.
* management of IT/facilities items; support periodic stock checks and flag discrepancies; provide first line IT support where required.
* Support budget administration by maintaining finance system records, and helping compile routine inputs for invoice reconciliation, charging instructions, and cash accounting and reporting.
* Support contract/supplier administration and procurement by maintaining registers, tracking renewal dates, collating quotes and preparing simple summaries.
* Undertake other reasonable duties as required in line with the FCDO’s agile workforce approach.



**Essential qualifications, skills and experience**





* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken, minimum of C1 level for CEFR\*);
* Strong interest in business administration, office management, human resources or finance operations, and enthusiasm for developing invoice\-processing and systems administration skills.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail; ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
* Strong IT and numeracy skills (e.g. Sharepoint, Outlook, Excel) and willingness to learn new systems quickly.
* Confidence handling invoices, figures, administrative/financial systems, and supplier relationships.
* Professional communication skills, with a helpful, customer\-focused approach.
* Problem\-solving mentality with a readiness to take ownership of end\-to\-end processes.
* Ability to handle information sensitively and maintain confidentiality.



**Desirable qualifications, skills and experience**





* Additional language skills ( and/or French);
* Any prior exposure to invoice processing, bookkeeping, finance administration, or office management environments (paid, unpaid, academic or placement\-based).
* Degree or Certified qualification in Office Management, Business Administration, Finance, HR or related field.



Working hours per week: 40



Monthly allowance: CHF 2,190



Preferred start date: 14 December 2026







**Other benefits and conditions of employment:**





This is a full\-time, 6 months internship contract of 40 hours per week inclusive of four compulsory 45\-minute lunch breaks.



Embassy opening hours are 0730 – 1830 hrs (Monday – Thursday) and 0730 – 1330 hrs (Friday).



The annual leave entitlement is 25 days per year, and the Embassy also enjoys 13 Swiss/ UK public holidays per year. These are prorated.



The successful candidate will be subject to professional background and security clearances before a contract is offered.



FCDO is committed to continual learning and development. The Embassy will provide funding in line with L\&D requirements, and a variety of learning and development is provided throughout the year both directly at post and virtually through the FCDO International Academy. There will be opportunities to attend training, lectures etc. on the job.



Visa/work permit requirements: The successful candidate must have pre\-existing work authorisation for Switzerland in order to apply. All applicants should have the right to live and work in Switzerland.



**Equal employment:**



We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. We particularly encourage applications from candidates with protected characteristics. FCDO want to maximise the potential of everyone who chooses to work for us, regardless of their background.



**Additional information:**





Please note that the deadline for applications is 23:55 on the day mentioned in the above field “Application deadline”.



We advise you to allow enough time to complete and submit your full application, since only applications completed and submitted before the deadline will be considered.



Please be aware that the deadline for submitting applications is considered to be the time zone for the country where the vacancy has arisen.



The British Diplomatic Missions will not be able to meet the travel costs incurred when travelling to the interview, nor the costs connected with relocation if offered a job.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre organisation Food \& Beverage, nous recherchons un(e) Restaurant Manager pour venir compl\éter notre équipe et former un véritable binôme avec notre Restaurant Manager actuellement en poste.



Les deux Restaurant Managers occupent le même niveau hiérarchique, avec les mêmes responsabilités. Ensemble, ils donnent l'impulsion au restaurant, accompagnent les équipes et garantissent la qualité et la régularité de l'expérience client.



Notre restaurant fonctionne 7 jours sur 7, du petit\-déjeuner au dîner, soit 21 services par semaine. L'organisation en duo permet d'assurer une présence managériale sur l'ensemble de ces services. Elle nécessite donc une excellente communication, une confiance réciproque et une collaboration permanente entre les deux Restaurant Managers.



L'esprit d'équipe n'est pas seulement une qualité recherchée : il est au cœur du fonctionnement du poste.

**Restaurant Manager**

Vos principales responsabilités



En collaboration étroite avec votre binôme, vous aurez notamment pour missions de :



* Organiser, coordonner et superviser les équipes de salle et les extras ;
* Assurer, avec l'autre Restaurant Manager, une continuité managériale sur les 21 services hebdomadaires ;
* Préparer et animer les briefings et transmettre efficacement les informations entre les différents services ;
* Être présent(e) sur le terrain et participer activement aux services ;
* Garantir la qualité de l'accueil, du service et de l'expérience client ;
* Veiller au respect et à l'évolution des standards de service de l'établissement ;
* Former, accompagner et faire progresser les collaborateurs ;
* Développer une communication fluide et constructive avec votre binôme, la cuisine et les autres départements ;
* Superviser les mises en place, la propreté, l'ambiance et la bonne tenue du restaurant ;
* Participer activement au développement des ventes et à la satisfaction de nos clients ;
* Suivre les stocks, le matériel et les encaissements et contribuer à la maîtrise des coûts ;
* Participer, selon les besoins de l'activité, aux banquets, événements et autres activités F\&B.


Ces responsabilités sont directement en ligne avec le cahier des charges, qui confie au Restaurant Manager la coordination du personnel, la qualité du service et la satisfaction client. Il est également responsable de la formation des collaborateurs, des stocks et du bon déroulement du service.



Le profil que nous recherchons



Vous disposez d'une expérience réussie dans la restauration, idéalement en hôtellerie, et avez déjà exercé une fonction d'encadrement opérationnel.



Vous êtes avant tout un(e) manager de terrain : vous aimez être présent(e) pendant les services, accompagner votre équipe, montrer l'exemple et créer une dynamique positive.



Mais surtout, vous aimez travailler en équipe. Vous savez partager l'information, prendre des décisions en concertation, passer le relais et travailler avec un autre manager sans logique de territoire ou de concurrence.



Nous recherchons une personnalité capable de comprendre qu'un duo managérial performant repose sur la confiance, la communication et la cohérence des décisions prises devant les équipes.



Organisé(e), positif(ve), réactif(ve) et doté(e) d'un véritable sens du service, vous savez également garder votre maîtrise dans les périodes de forte activité.



La maîtrise du français est indispensable et un bon niveau d'anglais est nécessaire compte tenu de notre clientèle internationale.



Ce que nous proposons



* CDI à 100 %
* Horaires fixes avec horaires coupés
* Une organisation reposant sur deux Restaurant Managers de même niveau hiérarchique
* Un véritable rôle de management et d'animation des équipes
* Une forte présence opérationnelle sur le terrain
* Un environnement hôtelier 4 étoiles avec une clientèle locale et internationale
* Une fonction offrant autonomie, responsabilités et possibilité de faire évoluer l'expérience restauration



Entrée en fonction : à convenir



Vous êtes convaincu(e) que deux managers qui communiquent, se complètent et avancent dans la même direction peuvent créer une véritable dynamique d'équipe ?



Rejoignez Everness et construisez avec votre binôme l'impulsion quotidienne de notre restaurant.
