jobs.title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.

The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.

The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.

ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.

The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology

If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.

1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestock
We are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology
We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)

Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Read the full text and apply online

jobs.title: Tender Project Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Energy is the foundation of a functioning society — and the energy systems of the future require well‑engineered, competitive, and reliable solutions. Are you interested in working close to technology, cost, and delivery in some of the world’s most advanced power transmission projects?

Hitachi Energy delivers power grid technologies that supply electricity to more than three billion people worldwide. We are now looking for a Tender Project Engineer to join our HVDC organization in Ludvika, Sweden.

As a Tender Project Engineer, you support the early phases of HVDC projects by defining technical solutions and contributing to competitive tender proposals. You work closely with engineering, commercial, project management, and supply chain teams to define technical solutions, scope, risks, and cost drivers.

You contribute to shaping complete system solutions and ensure that technical proposals meet customer requirements, internal standards, and contractual conditions — all under demanding timelines.

This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Lead and coordinate technical work during the tender and proposal phases
    Analyze and interpret customer specifications and technical requirements
    Collaborate with the engineering, supply chain and project management teams to develop cost-optimized HVDC-system solutions
    Identify technical risks, constraints and opportunities and propose mitigation during the tender phase
    Provide accurate technical inputs to costing, planning assumptions and commercial offers
    Preparation of technical documentation for tenders and customer submissions
    Participate in technical meetings with customers and internal stakeholders
    Handover of technical scope to project execution teams

Your background

    Clear communication and coordination skills
    Experience in engineering, project engineering or technical projects
    Knowledge of HVDC, power systems, or energy infrastructure is a plus
    A structured approach to technical and commercial complexity
    Strong analytical mindset with the ability to balance technical-, cost-, schedule-, and risk factors
    Tender, proposal, contract, or customer requirements experience is a plus
    Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

Are you ready for a new and exciting opportunity? Does this role sound like a good match for your skills and ambitions? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

Recruiting Manager Perilla Kilström, pernilla.kilstrom@hitachienergy.com, will answer your questions about the position. All other questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Oliver Chicaiza, oliver.chicaiza@hitachienergy.com

jobs.title: Senior Test Lead  Quality Assurance & Test Management - 20099
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Job Overview

Assignment Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Lead to take overall responsibility for testing activities within a large-scale IT programme. You will define and drive the test strategy, coordinate testing teams, and ensure that testing is aligned with technical requirements and business objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, agile team leads, and internal and external delivery teams to ensure effective test planning, execution, risk management, and quality reporting.

What You Will Work On

    Define and maintain the overall test strategy and test plan.
    Establish testing scope, objectives, deliverables, test data, and environment requirements.
    Lead and coordinate testing activities and test execution across teams.
    Monitor test progress, defects, and quality metrics.
    Identify testing risks and define appropriate mitigation actions.
    Communicate test status, issues, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
    Coordinate QA, business, and delivery teams to ensure testing meets business and technical needs.
    Maintain test plans, test cases, test results, and defect reports.
    Support testing practices in Agile and DevOps environments.
    Work with CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.

What You Bring

    Proven experience as a Test Lead in large and complex IT programmes.
    Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
    Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
    Experience leading teams and coordinating end-to-end testing activities.
    Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
    Good understanding of CI/CD processes and test automation frameworks.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills.
    Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
    Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious

    Experience with AWS services.
    Experience with test case management tools.
    Experience with JMeter or similar performance testing tools.
    Experience in large-scale and complex technology environments.
    ISTQB Certified Test Manager or equivalent certification.

jobs.title: Telineasentaja, rakennustelineet ja sääsuojarakenteet (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Kiinteistöjen rakennus- ja saneeraustöiden tekeminen laadukkaasti sekä turvallisesti edellyttää tarkoituksenmukaisia teline- ja sääsuojaratkaisuja. Erikoistuminen ja tasokas ammattiosaaminen pitää yrityksen tilauskannan positiivisena seesteisinäkin aikoina ja ympäri vuoden sekä luo kasvupotentiaalia. Etsimmekin nyt telineasentajaa alalla jo vuosikymmeniä toimineen asiakasyrityksemme tehtäviin pääkaupunkiseudulle pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työt koostuvat rakennustelineiden ja sääsuojarakenteiden / sääsuojien asennus- ja purkutehtävistä. Työt tehdään ryhmässä tai asentajaparin kanssa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä ympäristökunnissa ja niihin tyypillisesti kuljetaan omalla autolla. Työntekijälle maksetaan TES:n mukainen korvaus päivittäisistä matkakustannuksista kotoa työkohteeseen sekä km-korvaus mahdollisista työkohteiden välisistä ajoista. Tekijän asuinpaikasta riippuen useimpiin työkohteisiin pääsee joustavasti myös julkisilla liikennevälineillä.

Työ on arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä klo 7:00 - 15:30, pääasiassa 40 h/vko. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä jonkin verran vaihtelua. Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kokemuksen ja sopimuksen mukaisesti.

Arvostamme hakijassa luonnollisesti kokemusta vastaavista asennustöistä, sillä telineiden ja konsoleiden asennus lujasti ja turvallisesti on ensisijaisen tärkeätä. Otamme haussa huomioon myös alaa kokemattomat tehtävään soveltuvat hakijat. Työssä menestymiseen siivittää halu sekä kyky aktiiviseen ja fyysiseen tekemiseen sekä vastuullinen työote. Oleellista on säilyttää toimintakyky korkeammallakin työskennellessä. Tehtävään annetaan asianmukainen perehdytys ja kollegoiden tuki sekä työhön kuuluvat varusteet.

Tehtävässä voidaan aloittaa pikaisestikin sopivan henkilön löydyttyä kauttamme määräaikaisella vuokratyösuhteella, jonka päätteeksi tekijän on tarkoitus jatkaa vakituisessa työsuhteessa asiakasyrityksessämme pitkäaikaisesti.

Tässä on toimeliaalle tekijälle hyvä työ hyvin hoidetussa ja työntekijöistään välittävässä yrityksessä. Tarjoamme työvaatetuksen, perustasoa kattavammat työterveyspalvelut sekä Clickin oman yhteyshenkilön vahvan tuen.

Haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten täytähän pikaisesti hakemus oheisen linkin kautta. Voit laittaa hakemuksen ja ansioluettelosi myös sähköpostilla. Kerro hakemuksessa mahdollisimman tarkasti osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointia hoitava rekrytointikonsultti Jan Kollin puhelimitse arkisin klo 9.00-16.00. Puh. 050 411 0390 ja sähköposti on muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi

jobs.title: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
jobs.employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

Responsibilities
You will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

  • Meeting room and conferencing equipment

  • IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

  • Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

  • A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

  • Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

  • Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

  • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet perheohjaajana Turussa sijaitsevassa lastensuojelun perhekuntoutusyksikössä, joka on osa Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueen omien lastensuojelulaitosten kokonaisuutta.

Perheohjaajana vastaat yhdessä työryhmän kanssa perheiden tilanteen kartoituksesta sekä tavoitteellisesta kuntoutusprosessin mukaisesta työskentelystä. Asiakasperheiden elämäntilanteet ovat usein kriisiytyneitä, ja he tarvitsevat tehostettua lastensuojelullista tukea. Työskentelysi voi tapahtua päivittäin kuntoutusasunnossa perheen arjen rinnalla tai intensiivisesti perheen omassa kodissa.

Työtäsi ohjaavat suhdeperustainen työote, systeeminen ajattelu sekä muutokseen tähtäävä tavoitteellisuus. Hyödynnät työssäsi mentalisaatio- ja kiintymyssuhdeperusteista arviointia ja kuntoutusta.

Toimit osana moniammatillista tiimiä ja laajaa verkostoa, jossa lapsi ja hänen perheensä ovat kaiken työn keskiössä. Vahvistat työssäsi lapsen asemaa ja näkökulmaa perheessä sekä hyödynnät erilaisia työmenetelmiä ja tiimin yhteistä osaamista.

Työpaikan osoite on Kunnallissairaalantie 36, 20810 Turku.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn lastensuojelun perhekuntoutuksessa, jossa pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti perheiden arjen ja muutoksen tukena.

Saat työsi tueksi säännöllisen työnohjauksen sekä perheterapeutin konsultaation. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa tiimissä, jossa osaamista jaetaan ja kehitetään yhdessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, itseohjautuvuutta sekä kykyä kuunnella ja kohdata empaattisesti. Tärkeää on myös valmius ottaa asioita puheeksi rakentavalla tavalla.

Toivomme sinulta kiintymyssuhdeymmärrystä sekä traumasensitiivistä työotetta. Aikaisempi kokemus lastensuojelutyöstä luetaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistotasoinen tutkinto. Tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Odotamme hakemustasi - tule mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä perheiden kanssa!

jobs.title: Site Manager till FirstOffice Stockholm
jobs.description:
Om företaget

FirstOffice, en affärsenhet inom det börsnoterade fastighetsbolaget Corem, erbjuder flexibla kontorslösningar med arbetsplatser, mötesrum och service i professionella och inspirerande miljöer. Konceptet bygger på att det ska vara enkelt att flytta in och enkelt att vara kund – kontor, service och gemensamma ytor samlas i en flexibel helhetslösning där företagen kan fokusera på sin egen verksamhet.

Läs mer om FirstOffice här: FirstOffice

Om rollen

Som Site Manager ansvarar du för flera av FirstOffice enheter i Stockholm. Rollen är bred, självständig och affärsnära, där du är naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten och har regelbunden kontakt med kunder och medlemmar. Du arbetar med allt från visningar, uthyrning och inflyttningar till att lösa praktiska frågor och säkerställa att service och drift håller en hög nivå.

Teamet du ingår i utgår från Kista och där finns även FirstOffice tjänstebilar. Du kommer att ha fasta dagar då du jobbar från kontoret i Kista och övriga dagar utgår du från de FirstOffice-enheter du ansvarar för.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du för att skapa en välfungerande vardag för våra kunder och samtidigt driva affären framåt. Du arbetar både operativt och relationsskapande, med tydligt fokus på service, uthyrning och resultat.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Driva och utveckla dina enheter mot uppsatta mål inom uthyrning, kundnöjdhet och resultat

    

Bearbeta leads, genomföra visningar och driva uthyrningsprocessen från första kontakt till tecknat avtal

    

Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med både befintliga och potentiella kunder

    

Säkerställa en hög servicenivå och en välfungerande daglig drift på enheterna

    

Arbeta aktivt med nätverkande, kundaktiviteter och lokal marknadsbearbetning

    

Ansvara för budget, resultatuppföljning samt planering och utveckling av dina enheter

    

Samarbeta nära med övriga Site Managers, Service Managers och andra funktioner inom FirstOffice och Corem

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som trivs i en bred och operativ roll där du är nära både verksamheten och kunderna. Du har ett naturligt affärsdriv, tycker om att bygga relationer och ser möjligheter i det dagliga kundmötet. Du är prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och trivs med att växla mellan kundkontakt, praktiska frågor och administration. För dig är hög service och en välfungerande drift grunden för nöjda kunder och goda resultat. Du kommunicerar tydligt och professionellt, är lyhörd för människor omkring dig och trivs i en miljö där det förväntas att du tar egna initiativ.

För att trivas i rollen ser vi gärna att du:

    

Har erfarenhet av försäljning, kundnära och affärsdriven roll

    

Är strukturerad och van vid att självständigt planera och prioritera ditt arbete

    

Har god administrativ förmåga och är bekväm med budget, uppföljning och digitala verktyg

    

Är kommunikativ, lyhörd och tydlig i samarbetet med såväl kunder som kollegor

    

Är prestigelös och trivs med att växla mellan operativa, praktiska och mer affärsstrategiska arbetsuppgifter

    

Har eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet

    

Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift

    

Har B-körkort

Tidigare erfarenhet från kontorshotell, coworking, fastighet, uthyrning eller liknande serviceverksamhet är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet och din förmåga att skapa förtroende och få saker att hända.

Om Carotte

Carotte Staff är Carotte Groups specialistbolag för bemanning och rekrytering inom service och värdskap. Med 40 års erfarenhet av servicebranschen i ryggen levererar vi självgående och engagerad personal till hotell, konferens, kontorsservice, restaurang och fastighetsmiljöer. Genom Carotte Academy utbildar vi kontinuerligt våra konsulter inom service och värdskap. Vi finns med kontor i Stockholm och Göteborg och verkar över hela Sverige.

Ansökan

Detta är ett hyrrekrytering via Carotte Staff, vilket innebär att du inledningsvis är anställd av oss och därefter går över i tillsvidareanställning hos FirstOffice. Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning Arbetstider: kontorstider Startdatum: Omgående

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på Carotte Staff.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Sökord: Site manager, reception, Stockholm, hotellreception, coworking, konferenschef, receptionschef, receptionsansvarig, konferensansvarig, serviceansvarig, platschef, platsansvarig, konferens, konferensvärdinna, konferensvärd

jobs.title: Diakon
jobs.description:
Karis-Pojo svenska församling lediganslår en diakontjänst. Diakoniarbetarna i församlingen utför klient- och påverkansarbete, uppsökande arbete samt organiserar frivilligverksamheten och den samlande verksamheten inom diakonin. Församlingen utvecklar sitt diakonala arbete bland familjer, barn och ungdomar. Till arbetsuppgifterna hör också själavård, att hålla andakter samt att medverka i gudstjänstliv och i församlingens övriga verksamhet enligt behov.

Vi söker dig som har god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga till självständigt arbete.

Du har intresse och förmåga att arbeta med ungdomar, barn och familjer, att utveckla det diakonala arbetet bland dem samt erfarenhet av och förmåga till självständigt och mångsidigt klientarbete.
Uppgifterna kräver ofta förflyttning mellan församlingens olika områden, tillgång till bil är därför önskvärt. Församlingens arbetsspråk är svenska, men i samarbetet med andra aktörer behövs kunskaper i finska. I klientarbetet behövs också andra språk.

Behörighetskrav är fastställda i kyrkans författningssamling nr 162. Språkkrav enligt kap. 8 §4 i kyrkoordningen. Övriga kunskaper än svenska och finska ses som merit.
Lön utbetalas enligt kravgrupp 503 i KyrkTAK.
Den som utses till tjänsten förväntas vara konfirmerad medlem av den evangelisk-lutherska kyrkan (KL 6 §1).
Till ansökan bifogas meritförteckning samt arbetsintyg.
På tjänsten tillämpas sex månaders prövotid.
Den som väljs till tjänsten skall uppvisa i straffregisterlagens 6 § avsedda registerutdrag samt förete intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd.
Arbetet inleds 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.
Ansökan inlämnas senast 3.11.2026.
Sökande ombeds reservera torsdag 5.11.2026 för eventuell intervju.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator Miele Professional Sverige
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on marketing professional who enjoys turning ideas into action? Would you like to take ownership of local marketing activities while being part of a global premium brand?

At Miele Professional, we are looking for a proactive and digitally skilled Marketing Coordinator to join our B2B team in Solna. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, combining digital marketing, campaign execution, content creation and close collaboration with sales and international marketing teams.

Your role

As Marketing Coordinator for Sweden, you will be responsible for coordinating and implementing local marketing activities within our HCS and LMD customer segments. You will play a key role in bringing regional and international marketing strategies to life in the Swedish market, ensuring that campaigns, product launches and communication activities are relevant, engaging and effectively executed.

This is a hands-on role with considerable independence, where you will work closely with the Swedish sales and service teams while collaborating with regional marketing colleagues and other stakeholders across our international organisation.

What you will be doing

Bringing marketing plans to life

You will translate regional marketing strategies and corporate objectives into effective local activities for the Swedish market. This includes coordinating product launches, promotions and marketing campaigns, ensuring that international initiatives are successfully adapted and implemented locally.

Working closely with the Regional Marketing Directors you will provide local market insights and input regarding products, consumables, digital services and pricing.

Driving digital marketing and customer engagement

A key part of your role will be to attract new customers, strengthen brand awareness and support customer retention, both directly and through our partners. You will coordinate and execute lead generation initiatives and digital marketing activities, ensuring that Miele Professional remains visible and relevant across digital channels.

You will also create, adapt and enrich local marketing content, including articles, customer success stories and reference cases for online and offline communication. Ensuring the quality and relevance of our Swedish marketing materials will be another important responsibility.

Supporting sales and strengthening Mieles premium positioning

You will work closely with our Swedish sales and service teams to ensure that marketing activities support commercial priorities and customer needs.

This includes developing and providing relevant sales and marketing materials, as well as planning and coordinating local events, trade fairs and training activities in line with corporate.

Managing project, budgets and stakeholders

You will coordinate the local marketing plan and budget, ensuring that activities are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.

As part of an international matrix organisation, you will collaborate with a broad network of stakeholders, including the Regional Management Team, sales and service teams, business partners, marketing colleagues across North West Europe and external marketing agencies.

Who are you?

We believe you are an experienced and hands-on marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. You have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and know how to turn marketing strategies into practical activities that generate results. You are equally comfortable coordinating a digital campaign, adapting content for a local audience, supporting a product launch or collaborating with sales colleagues on lead generation initiatives.

You thrive in an international environment, enjoy working with different stakeholders and are confident managing several projects simultaneously. Most importantly, you are someone who takes initiative, identifies opportunities and drives activities forward independently, while knowing when to involve and collaborate with others.

Your background

We are looking for someone with:

· A bachelor's or master's degree in marketing or a related field.

· Relevant marketing experience, with a strong operational and hands-on focus.

· Experience coordinating and implementing local marketing activities in line with regional or international strategies.

· Proven digital marketing experience, including areas such as performance marketing, SEO, social media and AI-supported marketing tools.

· Excellent Swedish communication and strong communication skills in English.

· Experience working in an international matrix organisation and managing cross-functional projects is an advantage.

What we offer

At Miele Professional, you will have the opportunity to work with a well-established global premium brand in a role that combines local ownership with international collaboration.

You will be part of a professional and supportive environment where your initiative, expertise and ability to deliver results can make a real difference.

Practical information

Location: Solna, Sweden

Employment: Full-time, temporary position covering parental leave

Period: Ideally November 2026 – February 2028

Ready to make an impact?

We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about how you could contribute to Miele Professional's continued growth in Sweden.

Meritorious

Tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiakkuuksien johtaminen, tavoitteellinen myyntityö, markkinoinnin suunnittelu sekä projektien koordinointi yhteistyössä MainosLähteen asiantuntijatiimin kanssa.

Keskeiset työtehtäväsi

**Asiakkuuksien hoitaminen ja kehittäminen**

- Vastaat nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaisesta hoitamisesta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä.

- Rakennat ja ylläpidät pitkäaikaisia, luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita.

- Tunnistat asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan tavoitteita ja kehität heidän markkinointiaan yhdessä asiantuntijatiimimme kanssa.

- Suunnittelet ja toteutat asiakastapaamisia sekä huolehdit aktiivisesta yhteydenpidosta.

- Tunnistat nykyisissä asiakkuuksissa uusia yhteistyö- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia.


**Uusasiakashankinta ja myyntityö**

- Vastaat aktiivisesta uusasiakashankinnasta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta.

- Kontaktoit potentiaalisia asiakkaita ja sovit asiakastapaamisia.

- Kartoitat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja esittelet heille soveltuvia markkinointi- ja viestintäratkaisuja.

- Laadit tarjouksia ja osallistut sopimusneuvotteluihin.

- Viet myyntiprosesseja suunnitelmallisesti eteenpäin ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta asiakkuuden käynnistämiseen.

- Seuraat omaa myyntityötäsi ja sen tuloksellisuutta.


**Markkinoinnin ratkaisujen suunnittelu ja myynti**

- Osallistut asiakkaiden markkinoinnin tavoitteiden ja kehitystarpeiden määrittelyyn.

- Suunnittelet yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa asiakkaille sopivia palvelukokonaisuuksia.

- Myyt MainosLähteen palveluita, kuten verkkosivustojen suunnittelua ja toteutusta, hakukoneoptimointia (SEO), tekoälyhakuihin liittyvää näkyvyyden kehittämistä (GEO), Google Ads -mainontaa, sosiaalisen median markkinointia, sisällöntuotantoa, brändäystä sekä valo- ja videotuotantoja.

- Osallistut markkinointikampanjoiden suunnitteluun, tavoitteiden määrittelyyn ja tulosten arviointiin.

- Autat asiakkaita ymmärtämään markkinoinnin eri mahdollisuuksia ja niiden vaikutuksia liiketoimintaan.


**Projektien koordinointi ja yhteistyö**

- Toimit asiakkaan ja MainosLähteen tuotantotiimin välisenä yhteyshenkilönä.

- Huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakasprojektit etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulujen ja budjettien mukaisesti.

- Välität asiakastarpeet ja projektien tavoitteet selkeästi toteutuksesta vastaaville asiantuntijoille.

- Osallistut projektien suunnitteluun, aikatauluttamiseen ja seurantaan.

- Varmistat sujuvan asiakasviestinnän ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen projektien eri vaiheissa.


**Asiakkuuksien ja myynnin tuloksellisuuden seuranta**

- Seuraat asiakkuuksien kehittymistä, myynnin tavoitteiden toteutumista ja asiakastyytyväisyyttä.

- Huolehdit asiakastietojen ja myyntimahdollisuuksien ajantasaisuudesta käytössä olevissa järjestelmissä.

- Osallistut asiakkuuksien kannattavuuden ja palvelukokonaisuuksien kehittämiseen.

- Tuot esiin uusia ideoita ja kehitysehdotuksia MainosLähteen palveluiden sekä toimintatapojen kehittämiseksi.


Millainen rooli sinulla on tiimissämme?

Asiakkuuspäällikön tehtävä on itsenäinen ja vastuullinen, mutta et työskentele yksin. Tukenasi on MainosLähteen markkinoinnin, digitaalisten ratkaisujen, visuaalisen suunnittelun ja sisällöntuotannon osaamista.

Sinun ei tarvitse itse hallita kaikkien markkinointipalveluiden teknistä toteutusta. Tärkeintä on, että ymmärrät asiakkaiden tarpeita, osaat keskustella markkinoinnin mahdollisuuksista ja pystyt rakentamaan toimivia ratkaisuja yhteistyössä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työskentelyysi, kehittämään asiakkuuksia pitkäjänteisesti ja osallistumaan myös MainosLähteen liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen.

**Työn keskeinen tavoite on luoda kannattavia ja pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita, kasvattaa uusasiakashankinnan kautta yrityksen myyntiä sekä varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat markkinoinnistaan mahdollisimman paljon hyötyä.**

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Pyhännälle
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary – Section 1  

As a certification engineer in our Global Unit TGRMHCE- E/E, Software and Autonomous Certification you will follow our various development projects and you will plan, support and oversee the certification activities in cooperation with our Technical Services inspectors, the accountable design and testing groups/units from TRATON R&D. Additionally you will support the legal requirement analysis in product development regarding global regulations but also market-specific legislation and you will closely monitor the need of certification in coordination with coming new legislation.

This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden

Job Responsibilities

    Coordinate, plan and oversee certification activities within the technical area of E/E, Software and Autonomous products and ADAS -Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
     Be part of the homologation process —with a specific focus on E/E, Software and Autonomous projects —working within a dynamic environment and in close cooperation with technical departments, project teams and technical services.
     Compile approval documentation for vehicles and vehicle components and provide operational assistance in obtaining UNECE/ EU and national approvals worldwide.
     Prepare documentation in accordance with technical specifications and submit documents and products to international type approval authorities to obtain the necessary approvals.

Who You Are

You are a person that take initiative, enjoy learning new things and like to work with many different groups and colleagues. The work is both individual and collaborative which demand skills in communication and cooperation. The work and contacts is within TRATON, mainly R&D, but also externally with third party certification bodies and in some cases various extent vehicle industry working groups. You are good at creating team spirit and have the ability to share experiences and information with your colleagues in a generous way.

Previous experience from product compliance, product development and knowledge about the vehicle industry is beneficial but not necessary. You may also have experience from working with regulations, standardization and committee work.

As you may understand writing and speaking English is done on daily basis. You are interested in seeing the broader picture and when needed dig into the details. Eager to learn and an open mindset is very appreciated.

·      Engineering degree or equivalent qualification

·      Several years of professional experience in vehicle technology is appreciated but not mandatory

·      Enjoy working as part of a team and possess strong communication and planning skills

·      Business fluent proficiency in English. Swedish or German proficiency is appreciated besides English.

·      Highly analytical and creative mindset and ability to clearly structure and present complex interdependencies.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.

This Is Us

Our Global Unit TGRMHCE- E/E Software and Autonomous Certification, is working with certification and coming new legislation to approved and certified vehicles. We are working with approval of vehicles and systems in development projects, special order projects, product adaptations and product maintenance projects, for both trucks and buses. We are working closely with our design departments and with the other groups within TRATON R&D. For the approval of our products, we use third-party Technical Services and authorities.

·      Ensures certification compliance within the technical area of E/E, Software,  autonomous systems and ADAS -Advanced Driver Assistance Systems

·      Manages certification processes to comply with regulations for electronic, software,  autonomous systems and ADAS -Advanced Driver Assistance Systems

·      Coordinates activities with type approval authorities and technical services to meet regulations and standards in E/E , software and autonomous driving areas.

·      Provides oversight to ensure compliance in E/E, software and autonomous product certifications and performs legal analysis from a certification perspective.

TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Compliance Officer - AML & Sanctions to TFS Group Compliance Function
jobs.description:
Compliance Officer – AML & Sanctions to TFS Group Compliance Function



Role Summary

We are looking for a senior Compliance Officer – AML and Sanctions to join our Compliance Function at TFS Head Office. The role is part of the broader Anti-Financial Crime Compliance function, with a special focus on Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Sanctions.

The position reports to the Chief Compliance Officer and is functionally led the AFC Compliance Officer. Within this framework, you will have a high degree of autonomy and responsibility for providing regulatory expertise, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, advisory work and stakeholder management, with the opportunity to influence and strengthen how AML and Sanctions requirements are implemented across the organization.

You will work across a complex international environment, supporting not only TFS and its entities in multiple jurisdictions, but also offer the same AML support to our sister company Scania Group and its head office compliance function. We work in a collaborative environment also with other brands of the TRATON Group including MAN, International Motors and Volkswagen Truck & Bus.

The position is based in Stockholm/ Södertälje, with access to offices in both locations, with international exposure and some travel expected.  



Job Responsibilities

AML and Sanctions Adisory and Oversight  

Provide independent second-line advice and oversight on AML, CTF and Sanctions risks and regulatory requirements across the organization in TFS and Scania on AML. Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of relevant policies, processes and internal controls and provide expert compliance advice to business and senior stakeholders on complex AML and Sanctions matters.

Risk Assessments and Incident Oversight – Conduct and contribute to AML and Sanctions risk assessments, compliance monitoring and thematic reviews across regions and entities. Assess emerging financial-crime risks and control effectiveness, and provide recommendations and appropriate escalation of maternal issues, incidents and remediation activities.

Regulatory Framework Development - Contribute to the maintenance and continuous development of the AML and Sanctions compliance framework, including policies, standard, procedures and guidance. Provide specialist regulatory interpretation and translate regulatory developments into practical compliance requirements and recommendations. Support the effective implementation of AML and Sanctions requirements across relevant parts of the organisation.

Reporting & Advisory – Provide analysis and reporting on AML and Sanctions compliance, key risks, emerging issues and regulatory developments to relevant forums. Deliver forward-looking advice and recommendations to support informed decision-making and effective compliance oversight.

Stakeholder Engagement, Training & Collaboration - Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Risk, Legal and the business, including regional and entity level teams. Provide specialist guidance and support to colleagues on AML and Sanctions matters. Contribute to the development and delivery of AML and Sanctions training and awareness initiatives, and collaborate with stakeholders across TFS, Scania and the wider TRATON Group on relevant compliance activities and Group-wide initiatives.



Who You Are

You hold a Master’s degree and bring 7-10+ years of relevant experience from regulated environments, preferably within financial services, banking, insurance or similarly complex international structures.

You have deep expertise in:

    Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing
    Sanctions compliance and sanctions risk management
    AML and sanctions risk assessment
    Compliance monitoring and second line oversight
    Financial crime risks, typologies and emerging threats
    Regulatory interpretation and implementation
    Compliance frameworks, policies, and controls
    Working across complex international organizations

You have solid experience in AML regulated environments such as financial and banking services, captive finance or an internationally regulated financial institutions.

You are familiar with EU and Swedish AML and Sanctions requirements and have an understanding of international regulatory frameworks, including relevant UK and US requirements.

This Is Us

You will join a highly experienced and international GRC and Compliance Team at a time of continued development and increasing regulatory complexity. Our organization operates globally, supporting sustainable transportation through responsible financial services and you will have the ability to support and work with other colleagues in the compliance functions at both TFS and Scania as well as the respective global networks and business stakeholders.

The home office is based in Södertälje, with access to a group-wide hub in central Stockholm. We offer flexible working arrangements adapted to business needs and role requirements, including international collaboration and some travel.

TRATON Financial Services Offers

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal in Södertälje, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

More info provided on the website - please follow the link provided.

Application

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in tumor cell biology
jobs.description:
About the position

A 100% 3-year Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in tumor cell biology is available in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Cancer Society.

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the research team and external partners at Oslo University Hospital, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor RUNX2, using cancer cell lines and PDX mouse tumor models, for various cell-based assays. The work involves in vivo setups and is expected to necessitate optimizations. 

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Responsibilities
  • Design and execute PDX prostate cancer studies evaluating the effect of microprotein modulation and peptide therapy, using cell biological approaches.
  • Design and perform cellular assays to test microprotein function and transcription factor modulation.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records and contribute to data analysis and interpretation.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms and prepare manuscripts for publication.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Applicants must hold a doctoral degree – PhD or equivalent. 
  • If a doctoral degree is not yet awarded, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing application date. Hiring will however be contingent on obtention of a doctoral degree. 
  • Solid knowledge of, and experience in, (cancer) cell biology.  
  • Experience in tumor biology.
  • Experience with cell culture and/or patient-derived xenograft (PDX) tumor models.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English. 

Relevant Qualifications

  • Experience with molecular biology and/or epigenetics is positive. 
  • Authorization to work with laboratory animals (rodents) (e.g. LAS301, FELASA C) is a strong advantage. If you do not have such authorization, you will be required to acquire it in the first part of your employment. 
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment and access to top-notch equipment and resources.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 610 000 to 650 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment with rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities. 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter statement of your research interests and motivation for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • Copy of relevant certification(s) for laboratory animal work, if this applies
  • List of publications and academic works; do not include the publications themselves or your dissertation. 
  • List of 3 reference persons (name, relation to you, e-mail, phone number) 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

jobs.title: Verkkoinsinööri / Power System Engineer
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä sähköenergia-alan ytimessä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten sähköverkot suunnitellaan ja miten ne toimivat tulevaisuudessa? Etsimme Power Engineering -tiimiimme verkkoinsinööriä, joka osallistuu uusiutuvan energian sähköverkkoprojektien suunnitteluun ja analysointiin eri puolilla Suomea sekä kansainvälisesti.

Power Engineering -tiimin tehtävä on auttaa asiakkaitamme heidän projekteissaan tuottamalla heille arvokasta informaatio sähköteknisen laskennan, analyysien ja suunnittelun avulla heidän hankkeissaan.

Tässä tehtävässä roolisi mukautuu osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan – voit keskittyä esimerkiksi verkostolaskentaan, tekniseen suunnitteluun tai asiantuntijatukeen projekteissa. Olemme edelläkävijöitä uusiutuvan energian suunnittelussa ja meillä voit rakentaa juuri sinulle sopivan asiantuntijaroolin, jossa voit hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi. Desprolla työnteko ei ole sidoksissa paikkaan, vaan työtä voi tehdä joustavasti etänä tai toimistoiltamme useilla eri paikkakunnilta.



Tehtäväkenttäsi voi painottua eri tavoin – tässä esimerkkejä mahdollisista vastuualueista:

- Sähköverkon laskentojen tekeminen varmistaen verkon tehokkuuden ja luotettavuuden (kuormanjako-, loistehokapasiteetti-, vikavirta-, komponenttien kuormitus- ja mitoituslaskelmat sekä selektiivisyystarkastelut)


- Maadoituslaskelmat, -tarkastelut ja vaarajänniteselvitykset


- Verkkotietomallien ylläpito, kehittäminen sekä laskenta/analysointi


- Laskentatulosten analysointi ja raportointi suunnittelun tueksi


- Yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien välillä


- Dokumentaation laatiminen


- Osallistuminen sähköverkkosuunnittelun kehitysprojekteihin




Eduksi hakijalle lasketaan:

- Kokemus keski- ja suurjänniteverkkojen laskennasta ja suunnittelusta


- Tuntemus sähköverkon rakenteista ja toimintaperiaatteista


- Uusiutuvan energian järjestelmä- ja laitetuntemus


- Laskentaohjelmistojen (esim. PowerFactory, openDSS, PSCAD, PSS/E, Safegrid, Cableizer) hallinta


- Hyvät ongelmanratkaisu- ja analysointitaidot


- Tarkka, järjestelmällinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote


- Sujuva suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taito




Katsomme eduksi myös oppimishalukkuuden ja sinut perehdytetään työhösi, eli voit hakea työpaikkaa myös, vaikka et vielä osaisi kaikkea edellä mainittua.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Meillä tehdään merkityksellistä asiantuntijatyötä alan huipulla ja voidaan hyvin. Otamme henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnin ja osallistamisen tosissaan. Toimintaamme ohjaavat luottamus, rohkeus, arvostus ja vastuunotto. Onnistumme yhdessä joukkueena, toisiamme tukien.


- Rakennamme konkreettisin teoin hyvinvoivaa ja innostavaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen pääsee loistamaan omilla vahvuuksillaan. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan niin omaan työhösi kuin asiakkaiden ja koko yhteiskunnan energiatehokkaaseen tulevaisuuteen. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisia projekteja, erinomaiset henkilökuntaetuudet sekä kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme viimeisimmät laitteet ja ohjelmistot, jotta työnteko on mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan lisäksi pääset kehittymään huippuasiantuntijoiden joukkueessa, alan edelläkävijäyrityksessä.




Kiinnostuitko?

4 chauffører/montører søges – fast makker, egen rute og kundeservice i topklasse!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS søger 4 dygtige og ansvarsbevidste chauffører/montører til levering, indbæring og montering af hvidevarer og TV.

I bliver fordelt på to teams med to medarbejdere i hver 8-pallers liftbil. Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan samarbejde, tage ansvar og sikre, at kunden får en god oplevelse fra ankomst til færdig montering.

• Arbejdsdagene er mandag til fredag.
• Mødetid kl. 06.00 med forventet afslutning omkring kl. 15.00. Sluttidspunktet kan variere efter dagens opgaver.

• Opstilling og tilslutning af opvaskemaskiner.

Alle monterings- og tilslutningsopgaver skal udføres fagligt korrekt og efter gældende regler og producentens anvisninger.

Vi forventer, at du

• Har gyldigt kørekort til bilen og de nødvendige chaufførbeviser.

Vi tilbyder

• En varieret hverdag med både kørsel, kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.
• Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst.
• En arbejdsplads med direkte kontakt til ledelsen, tæt samarbejde og fokus på kvalitet.

Søg alene – eller sammen med din makker

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@nstransportdk.dk med emnet: “Chauffør/montør – Fredericia”.

Fortæl os:

• Hvilken erfaring du har med kørsel, hvidevarer og TV-montering.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette fire medarbejdere.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vi søger flere anlægsgartnere – bliv en del af en virksomhed i vækst!

Havens Nøgle søger dygtige og engagerede anlægsgartnere til vores voksende team!

Hos Havens Nøgle har vi travlt og oplever en stigende efterspørgsel på vores ydelser. Derfor søger vi flere medarbejdere, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores team og arbejde med spændende og varierede opgaver inden for anlægsgartneri og havearbejde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

Anlægning af haver og grønne områder

Plantning af træer, buske, blomster og øvrige planter

Beskæring af træer og buske

Anlægning af terrasser og indkørsler

Flisearbejde og belægningsopgaver

Hækkeklipning og almindelig havevedligeholdelse

Øvrigt forefaldende anlægs- og gartnerarbejde

Vi forventer, at du:

Har erfaring med anlægsgartnerarbejde eller lignende praktisk arbejde

Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og arbejdsom

Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med kollegaer

Har en positiv indstilling og sætter en ære i at levere et flot resultat

Trives med fysisk arbejde og udendørs opgaver i al slags vejr

En relevant uddannelse er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde og bidrage til vores fortsatte vækst.

Vi tilbyder:

En fuldtidsstilling på ca. 37 timer om ugen

Løn efter almindelige gældende lønvilkår og kvalifikationer

En alsidig arbejdsdag med forskellige opgaver

Gode kollegaer og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø

Mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed i udvikling

Ansøgning og kontakt

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til garden_key@outlook.dk.

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte os på 61 42 64 94 eller via e-mail, hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker at høre mere om stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Electrical Solutions Engineer, Data Centers
jobs.description:
Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. We enable the digitalization and electrification of society through reliable solutions for power, communication and renewable energy networks.

Do you want to help deliver the next generation of critical infrastructure? Eltel is now looking for a driven and enthusiastic Electrical Solutions Engineer to join our growing Data Center team.

In this role, you will support our Data Center team in developing and evaluating electrical solutions for large-scale data center projects. Rather than focusing solely on design or reviewing the existing, you will help ensure that proposed solutions are technically robust, commercially competitive, and ready for successful execution. You will provide technical input for bids and supplier evaluations while ensuring that solutions reflect Finnish industry practices, utility requirements, and proven construction methods. Your involvement will not end at contract award; you will continue to support project teams throughout delivery, helping to evaluate design changes, resolve technical challenges during construction and commissioning, and ensure that all agreed modifications are accurately reflected in the final project documentation and handover package. You will work closely with solutions sales, suppliers, and site teams, helping bridge the gap between engineering and construction.

Your key responsibilities

-
Review electrical designs: Review electrical designs, models, and drawings from a contractor's perspective.

-
Assess layouts & feasibility: Assess equipment layouts, cable routing, and installation feasibility.

-
Discipline coordination: Support the coordination of electrical, mechanical, automation, and structural disciplines.

-
Technical calculations: Review electrical load calculations, cable sizing, equipment selections, and protection concepts.

-
Material Take-Offs: Prepare equipment and material take-offs, including cable quantities.

-
Tendering & Procurement support: Support technical tendering, procurement, and supplier evaluation activities.

-
Supplier documentation: Review supplier documentation and coordinate technical clarifications.

-
Technical issue resolution: Assist project teams in resolving technical issues during project execution.

-
Documentation update: Help ensure that design changes are correctly implemented in project documentation.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a technically strong, energetic, and solution-oriented procurement professional who loves velocity, excels in dynamic, fast-moving projects, and wants to grow within a leading infrastructure company.

We expect you to have:

-
Degree: B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

-
Industry understanding: Good understanding of electrical distribution systems and infrastructure projects.

-
Evaluation skills: Ability to review and evaluate technical solutions and documentation.

-
Problem-solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-
Communication: Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders.

-
Language skills: Fluency in Finnish is required; English language skills are considered an asset.

Why should you apply to Eltel?

Our professionals describe Eltel as a flexible workplace that offers a wide range of expertise, diverse roles, and a well-balanced mix of freedom and responsibility. At Eltel, people work guided by our core values — always professionally, stronger together, caring for life, and creating new opportunities.

A skilled team around you - At Eltel, you are never alone. You have a reliable and collaborative team of professionals backing you up. This skilled and reliable team is a source of pride for us - that's why we can successfully handle even large EPC-projects. We encourage open-mindedness and curiosity to continuously find better ways to work.

A workplace where people care and grow stronger together - Team spirit and peer support consistently receive high marks in Eltels employee surveys. At Eltel, people look out for one another, follow safety protocols, and ensure that everyone gets home safely every day. Together, we create a positive working environment and strive for a healthy work-life balance.

Support your professional development - At Eltel we support your professional growth from day one. We are proud of the long careers our employees have built at Eltel, and we are committed to supporting their career development.

Employee benefits - Well-being, resilience, and job satisfaction are our key priorities. Eltel offers a wide range of benefits, including ePassi lunch and Flex benefits, a company phone, Auntie mental well-being service, and discounted services such as massage therapy.

Sounds interesting?

Submit your application through our recruitment system by 30.11. Please note that we process applications continuously and will proceed to interviews as soon as suitable candidates are found, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible!

For further information, please contact Sami Martikainen or Jesse Korhonen firstname.lastname@eltelnetworks.com. Email is the most efficient way to send a call request. For general questions regarding the recruitment process or Eltel, please contact rekrytointi@eltelnetworks.com

Read more about Eltel and our work with data centers: [Services for data centers](https://www.eltelnetworks.fi/fi/palvelut/services-for-data-centers/)

Follow us on social media:

LinkedIn: [Eltel Networks](https://www.linkedin.com/company/eltel-networks/)
Instagram: [eltelsuomi](https://www.instagram.com/eltelsuomi/)

Why join Eltel?

At Eltel, you will be part of a team delivering some of the most demanding and exciting infrastructure projects in the Nordics. We offer an opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, develop your expertise in mission-critical electrical systems and play a key role in projects that support the digitalization and electrification of society.
