l'offre jusqu'au suivi des travaux, à la réception et au contrôle de la rentabilité.

Missions principales

Gestion et suivi des chantiers

• Préparer les chantiers en amont : organisation, planification, besoins humains et matériels et
approvisionnements.
• Piloter et coordonner les équipes internes, fournisseurs et éventuels sous-traitants.
• Participer aux réunions de chantier et assurer le lien avec les clients, bureaux d'études et autres
intervenants.
• Suivre l'avancement des travaux et veiller au respect des délais, de la qualité d'exécution et des règles
de sécurité.
• Anticiper les difficultés techniques ou organisationnelles et mettre en place les actions correctives
nécessaires.
• Organiser la réception des travaux et assurer le suivi des éventuelles réserves.
Études, chiffrage et achats
• Analyser les demandes clients, plans, cahiers des charges et dossiers techniques.
• Réaliser les métrés, études de prix, chiffrages et devis pour les projets ne relevant pas des grilles
tarifaires standards.
• Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, comparer les offres et participer aux négociations.
• Proposer des solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins du client, en recherchant le meilleur équilibre
entre performance, faisabilité et coût.
• Intervenir aussi bien sur des projets professionnels et grands comptes que sur des projets résidentiels.
Suivi commercial et financier
• Être l'interlocuteur privilégié du client pendant toute la durée de l'affaire.
• Assurer le suivi commercial des offres et accompagner le client dans ses choix techniques.
• Suivre les budgets, les coûts, les achats et la marge des affaires confiées.
• Identifier et chiffrer les éventuels travaux supplémentaires.
• Transmettre les éléments nécessaires à la facturation et assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la
direction.

Profil recherché

• Expérience significative dans le domaine du chauffage et dans le suivi de chantiers, permettant une
prise en charge autonome des affaires.
• Bonne maîtrise du chiffrage, de la réalisation de devis et de l'analyse de dossiers techniques.
• Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires simultanément et à gérer les priorités.
• Sensibilité aux coûts, à la marge et à la rentabilité des chantiers.
• Organisation, rigueur, autonomie, réactivité et sens des responsabilités.
• Très bon relationnel et capacité à travailler avec les clients, équipes de terrain, fournisseurs et
partenaires.
• Maîtrise courante des outils informatiques et bureautiques ; la connaissance d'un logiciel de chiffrage
ou ERP constitue un atout.
• Permis B indispensable compte tenu des déplacements liés à la fonction.
• La connaissance du marché luxembourgeois et/ou des marchés publics et appels d'offres constitue un
atout.

Ce que nous offrons

• Un contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI) à temps plein.
• Un poste polyvalent avec une réelle autonomie et des responsabilités dès la prise de fonction.
• Un véhicule de société avec carte carburant.
• Les outils professionnels nécessaires à la fonction.
• Un environnement de travail à taille humaine, avec une chaîne de décision courte.
• Des projets variés et la possibilité de participer activement au développement de l'activité.
• De réelles perspectives d'évolution interne en fonction des compétences et de l'implication.

Lieu : Howald, Hesperange - déplacements principalement au Luxembourg et ponctuellement dans la Grande Région.

jobs.title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- A vásárlók megfelelő kiszolgálása, a vevői elégedettség növelése
- Az árukészlet napi szintű kezelése, áruátvétel
- Az áruk kihelyezése és feltöltése az üzletekben
- A termékszabványok ismerete és azok alkalmazása
- A bolt rendben tartása

AZ ÖN PROFILJA

- Kedves, mosolygós, dinamikus, csapatban szívesen dolgozó munkatársakat keresünk, aki szívesen foglalkozik emberekkel és mindenekelőtt szereti a cipőket.
- Kereskedelmi képesítés és/vagy tapasztalat előny!

AJÁNLATUNK

- Változatos feladatok egy nemzetközi divatcégnél, amelynek székhelye Ausztriában található.
- Kedves, hozzáértő csapat, amely átfogó betanítást biztosít szakmai tréningek keretében

Előnyök üzleteinkben:- Biztos, bejelentett munkahely

- Előrelépési lehetőség

- Természetbeni juttatás
- Barátságos légkör

Fizetés:- Megegyezés szerint

Akkor várjuk jelentkezési dokumentumait, és kérjük, hogy kizárólag online portálunkon keresztül jelentkezzen.

jobs.title: Customization Execution Lead (x|w|m) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
Werde Teil unseres Consumable Customization Services Teams als Customization Execution Lead (x|w|m) und übernimm eine zentrale Rolle bei der strategischen Steuerung und funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit in unserem Customization-Umfeld. In dieser Rolle verbindest du Sales, PM CCS, Customization Platform, Engineering, Operations und BPM, um Prioritäten, Abhängigkeiten und strategische Initiativen aufeinander abzustimmen. Durch Transparenz, fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Customization-Prozesse trägst du zu einem planbaren und skalierbaren Operating Model und damit zu besserer Gesundheit für mehr Menschen bei. Zu besetzen ist die Position am Standort Aubagne oder Göttingen mit der Möglichkeit, an einigen Tagen pro Woche remote zu arbeiten.

Wachse mit uns – deine Aufgaben

- Steuere die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, PM CCS, Customization Platform, Engineering, Operations und BPM und bringe unterschiedliche Prioritäten und Abhängigkeiten für eine effektive Umsetzung von Customization-Aktivitäten zusammen
- Entwickle und koordiniere strategische Projekt- und Programmpläne und definiere Ziele, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Deliverables im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen
- Analysiere die Geschäftsentwicklung im Customization-Umfeld sowie relevante Health-of-Business-Kennzahlen, identifiziere Abweichungen bei Durchlaufzeiten, wiederkehrende Engpässe und Umsetzungsrisiken und leite geeignete Maßnahmen ab
- Priorisiere Smart-Customization- und weitere Verbesserungsinitiativen anhand von Geschäftsauswirkungen, Umsetzbarkeit und organisatorischen Abhängigkeiten und unterstütze eine effektive Umsetzungsreihenfolge und Ressourcenfokussierung
- Stelle ein aussagekräftiges Management Reporting sicher, indem du KPIs, Risiken, offene Themen, Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen konsolidierst und Transparenz für regelmäßige Senior-Management-Reviews schaffst
- Steuere Execution Reviews und Eskalationsmechanismen, unterstütze die funktionsübergreifende Beseitigung von Umsetzungshindernissen und verfolge vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent nach
- Arbeite eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, steuere Erwartungen und sorge für eine gemeinsame Ausrichtung auf strategische Projekt- und Programmziele

Das bringst du mit

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Life Sciences, Projektmanagement oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung
- Mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung im geschäftsbezogenen Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, Business Steering, Business Operations, Operational Excellence oder einem vergleichbaren funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld
- Umfassendes Verständnis strategischer Business-Steering-Prozesse, Methoden und Tools kombiniert mit Kenntnissen von Customization-, Engineered-to-Order- und Quotation-to-Delivery-Prozessen in einem technischen B2B-Umfeld
- Fundierte Erfahrung im Performance Management, in der KPI-Steuerung, Ursachenanalyse und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten zur strukturierten Problemlösung
- Nachweisbare Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zu koordinieren, unterschiedliche Prioritäten zusammenzuführen und Stakeholder in globalen Matrixorganisationen einzubinden
- Ausgeprägtes strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen frühzeitig zu erkennen, Erkenntnisse in konkrete Maßnahmen zu überführen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen
- Mit deinen sehr guten Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten vermittelst du komplexe Informationen adressatengerecht, auch gegenüber dem Senior Management
- Eine detailgenaue und flexible Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich insbesondere bei Projektdokumentation und Reporting sowie im Umgang mit sich verändernden Anforderungen und Zeitplänen aus
- Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen

Deine Benefits

Als weltweit wachsendes Life-Science-Unternehmen, das im MDAX und TecDAX notiert ist, bietet Sartorius eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen:

- Raum für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung: Mentoring, Leadership-Programme, Talent-Gespräche, internes Seminar-Angebot
- Arbeite in deinem Rhythmus: Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten, Gleitzeit, flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
- Von Anfang an mitgestalten: Umfassendes Onboarding inklusive Online-Plattform – schon vor dem Einstieg, Workshops, „Buddy“ als Ansprechpartnerin bzw. Ansprechpartner  
- Internes Vernetzen: Communities zu zahlreichen Themen, wie Coaching, agiles Arbeiten und Yoga, Business Women Netzwerk
- Diese Position wird innerhalb der Sartorius Stedim FMT S.A.S. besetzt

Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Nationalitäten, Geschlechter, sexuellen Orientierungen, Religionen, Altersgruppen, Behinderungen und kulturellen Hintergründe.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. 



In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Sales Development Manager in New York, NY or San Francisco, CA that will recruit, develop, & lead a highly driven and hardworking team of Sales Development Representatives (Inbound) & Business Development Representatives (Outbound). We are looking for someone who is passionate about building a winning team and coaching & elevating the craft of new sellers at Notion. The Sales Development team is the first interaction with prospective Notion customers and is key to the success of our Sales organization!



At Notion the Sales Development team is responsible for driving new business opportunities and expanding market share through qualified pipeline, as well as driving the business forward by developing the next generation of top closers. As the Sales Development Lead you will be responsible for delivering both revenue and talent for our business. You will focus on the Recruitment, Enablement and Execution of your team to assure the continued successful trajectory of this strategically important department.



Our ideal candidate for this role has proven experience in managing, building and encouraging a team to achieve daily, weekly and monthly/quarterly targets in addition to delivering feedback to marketing and sales operations about lead quality and process improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 1. As an AMER Sales Development Manager, you will work directly with Sales Managers, cross functionally with Marketing Leadership, & Revenue Operations Leadership in creating and developing Notion’s Sales Development strategy, process and playbooks

 5. Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to ensure we capitalize on the massive market opportunity ahead of us

 6. Help build the foundations of Sales at Notion: As an early member of our sales org, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

 7. Join a fantastic team at a magical time: We've hit profitability and over 100 million users with a small team, which gives us a huge green field to work with. You'll join at the perfect time to shape how we grow from here.

 8. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with the product to inform what we do next.

 9. Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.
    
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience including either
   
   - 1-2 years managing a high-performing Sales Development team
   
   - 1-2 years Account Executive experience (and strong performance) at a SaaS company; after having successfully made the leap from Sales Development to Account Executive 

 - Strong track record of achieving sales targets across team and individual goals

 - Skilled in managing and coaching early-career salespeople

 - You have strong, recognized leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive mindsets, collaboration, and the ability to inspire a team of direct reports

 - You are comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of a high growth startup

 - You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of an early stage team

 - You view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

 - You have a high EQ and exceptional interpersonal skills, the ability to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building

 - You have an analytical mindset and enjoy problem-solving as part of a regional leadership team

 - You have strong empathy for customers and a passion for revenue and growth

 - You have a good understanding of value selling

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've built new business sales playbooks or processes

 - You've been a first or early hire at a fast-growing start-up before

 - Experience leading and improving Sales Development critical metrics

 - Experience running successful weekly and monthly team meetings

If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.



Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.


We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.
We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

 - Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

 - Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

 - Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

 - Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

 - Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

 - Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

 - Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

 - Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

 - Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

 - Fluency in an additional European language



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €85,000 - €95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Vil du være en del af væksten hos Jørgen Hansen Biler?
jobs.description:
Kan du følge med, når det går stærkt?

Det gør det hos os.

Vi oplever stor vækst. Salget af Kia og MG udvikler sig stærkt, kundetilgangen vokser, og med det nye Kia PV5-program står vi foran en spændende periode med endnu flere muligheder. Vi forventer, at udviklingen fortsætter, og at salget af både Kia og MG kun kommer til at gå endnu stærkere i de kommende år.

Derfor udvider vi holdet.

Vi søger en målrettet salgsrådgiver, der trives med mennesker, tempo og resultater. Du bliver en vigtig del af salgsafdelingen på tværs af vores afdelinger i Skærbæk og Esbjerg og får en alsidig arbejdsuge med kundekontakt, salg, opfølgning og samarbejde på tværs af begge bilhuse. Du bliver samtidig en del af et stærkt salgsteam med 8 salgsrådgivere, hvor sparring, samarbejde og vidensdeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Du kan lide, når der er fart på, tager ansvar for dine kunder og følger op på mulighederne, når de opstår. Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor ambitionerne er høje, beslutningsvejene korte, og hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit eget aftryk på resultaterne.

Din arbejdsuge kommer blandt andet til at bestå af:

  • Rådgivning af kunder om deres næste bil

  • Kundekontakt i butikken, på telefon og digitalt

  • Opfølgning på kundehenvendelser, prøvekørsler og leads

  • Opfølgning på aftaler og igangværende salg

  • Oprettelse og opdatering i vores salgs- og CRM-systemer

  • Klargøring af demobiler og biler til fremvisning

  • Sikre stærke kundeoplevelser i både Esbjerg og Skærbæk

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har drive og får ting til at ske

  • Trives med højt tempo og en arbejdsuge, hvor ikke to dage er ens

  • Tager initiativ og ansvar for dine egne opgaver

  • Motiveres af at skabe resultater

  • Følger op og ser opgaverne helt til dørs

  • Er god til mennesker og naturligt skaber relationer

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på aftaler, detaljer og opfølgning

  • Er fleksibel og trives med at arbejde på tværs af vores afdelinger

  • Har interesse for biler og salg

  • Har kørekort til personbil

Vi tilbyder:

  • En selvstændig og alsidig rolle på tværs af vores afdelinger i Esbjerg og Skærbæk

  • Et stærkt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger

  • En virksomhed i vækst med ambitioner og muligheder

  • Grundig oplæring i biler, systemer og salgsprocesser

  • Mulighed for mere ansvar i takt med din udvikling

  • Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Korte beslutningsveje og et arbejdsmiljø med højt humør

  • En arbejdsuge, hvor søndagsvagter er en naturlig del af jobbet, og hvor frihed planlægges på andre dage

 

Klar til at blive en del af holdet?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Indehaver Jørgen Hansen på +45 20 87 43 22 eller jorgen@jh-biler.dk.

Tiltrædelse ønskes snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til jorgen@jh-biler.dk med emnefeltet “Salgsrådgiver”.

Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: HAR DU STYR PÅ GARANTISAGER OG DETALJERNE BAG DEM?
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med garanti- og reklamationsbehandling i autobranchen, og motiveres du af at få tingene gjort rigtigt første gang?

Vi søger en garanti- og reklamationsmedarbejder, som kan tage ansvar for håndteringen af vores garanti- og reklamationssager fra start til slut. Du bliver en vigtig del af eftermarkedet og får en central rolle i at sikre korrekt sagsbehandling, dokumentation og opfølgning.

DINE OPGAVER

  • Oprette og behandle garanti- og reklamationssager

  • Indsende garantikrav til importører

  • Kontrollere arbejdsordrer og dokumentation

  • Sikre korrekt foto-, video- og diagnoserapportering

  • Følge op på manglende dokumentation og afviste sager

  • Holde styr på deadlines og gældende garantikrav

  • Styring og håndtering af reklamationshylder og reklamationsdele

  • Holde styr på liggetid på reklamationsdele og sikre korrekt opfølgning

  • Forberede og sikre, at dokumentation og reklamationsdele er klar, når der kommer garantirevision

  • Dialog med værksted, importører og teknisk support

  • Kontrollere garantisystemer og åbne servicekampagner

  • Diverse administrative opgaver i eftermarkedsafdelingen

Kort sagt: Du skal have styr på dine sager og sørge for, at de bliver afsluttet korrekt og til tiden.

 

VI SØGER DIG, DER

  • Har erfaring med garanti- og reklamationsbehandling i autobranchen

  • Arbejder struktureret og har øje for detaljerne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver

  • Kan håndtere gentagne administrative opgaver uden at miste fokus

  • Er god til at følge op og få tingene afsluttet

  • Har forståelse for værkstedets arbejdsgange

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at hjælpe, hvor der er behov

 

VI HJÆLPER HINANDEN

Selvom du har dit eget ansvarsområde, er du en del af et team.

Hos os hjælper vi hinanden på tværs af afdelingerne, når der er travlt, eller når kolleger holder ferie. Det betyder, at du også skal være indstillet på at løse andre relevante opgaver, når situationen kræver det.

Vi forventer, at du tager ansvar for dine egne opgaver – men også at du giver en hånd med, når kollegerne har brug for det.

 

HOS OS FÅR DU

En central rolle i en moderne bilforretning med flere mærker og et travlt eftermarked. Du får ansvar for dit eget område, men bliver samtidig en del af et stærkt team med tæt samarbejde mellem værksted, reservedele og administration.

Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, en uformel omgangstone og en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar for opgaverne. Samtidig får du stor indflydelse på dit eget ansvarsområde og mulighed for at præge de daglige arbejdsgange.

jobs.title: Varaosamyyjä Maakunnan Auto Seinäjoki
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

VARAOSAMYYJÄ Maakunnan Auto Seinäjoki

Haluatko olla tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että korjaamon työt etenevät sujuvasti ja asiakkaiden autot valmistuvat ajallaan?
Etsimme vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen varaosamyyjää Seinäjoen Maakunnan Autolle vahvistamaan Toyota-huoltomme varaosatiimiä.

Maakunnan Auto ja Autoliike Nystedt muodostavat yhdessä kuudella paikkakunnalla toimivan autoalan yrityksen, jossa työskentelee suuri joukko myynnin, huollon, korikorjauksen ja varaosatoimintojen ammattilaisia. Olemme osa Osuuskauppa KPO konsernia. Nyt etsimme tähän joukkoon uutta osaajaa Seinäjoen varaosatiimiin.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?
Varaosamyyjänä vastaat varaosien saatavuudesta Toyota-huollon ja vauriokorjaamon tarpeisiin. Huolehdit varaosien tilaamisesta, vastaanotosta, keräilystä ja varaston ylläpidosta sekä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä työnjohdon, huoltoneuvojien ja asentajien kanssa. Tehtävän keskiössä on korjaamomme toiminnan tukeminen ja korjaustöiden sujuvuuden varmistaminen.
Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:
varaosien tilaaminen ja hankinta huollon sekä vauriokorjaamon tarpeisiin
varaosien vastaanotto, tarkastus ja käsittely
varaosien keräily työmääräimille
varaosavaraston ylläpito ja kehittäminen
yhteistyö työnjohdon, huoltoneuvojien ja asentajien kanssa
varaosaratkaisujen etsiminen Toyota-ajoneuvoihin sekä muihin automerkkeihin

Toyota on päämerkkimme, mutta huollamme ja korjaamme kaikkia automerkkejä. Lisäksi toimipisteessämme toimii vauriokorjaamo, mikä tekee työstä monipuolisen ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamista laajasti autoalan jälkimarkkinoinnin parissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Arvostamme ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua oppia uutta.
Toivomme, että sinulla on:
kiinnostusta autoalaa ja ajoneuvotekniikkaa kohtaan
hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot
järjestelmällinen ja vastuullinen työote
kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti
halu kehittyä varaosa-alan ammattilaisena

Aiempi kokemus varaosamyynnistä tai autoalalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä. Perehdytämme tehtävään ja tuemme sinua onnistumaan työssäsi. B-ajokortti on tehtävässä tarpeellinen.

Mitä tarjoamme?
Tarjoamme sinulle:
vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn vakaassa ja tunnetussa yrityksessä
mahdollisuuden työskennellä alan johtavan automerkin, Toyotan, parissa
monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa näet läheltä huollon ja vauriokorjaamon arjen
osaavan sekä nuorekkaan työyhteisön
kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan kouluttautumismahdollisuuden
S-ryhmän ja Osuuskauppa KPO:n kattavat henkilöstöedut

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä hakemus ja cv viimeistään 31.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa huoltopäällikkö Jarkko Viitala, puh. 050 9136163.

120- vuotias Osuuskauppa KPO on lähes 1,2 miljardin euron vuosimyynnillään Suomen suurimpia alueosuuskauppoja. Toimimme Kokkolan, Pietarsaaren, Vaasan ja Ylivieskan talousalueilla. Olemme alueemme marketkaupan markkina- ja hintajohtaja sekä markkinajohtajia polttoneste-, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa. Lisäksi harjoitamme autokauppaa. Meillä on 140 000 asiakasomistajaa ja työllistämme noin 2 300 palvelualan ammattilaista. Osuuskauppa KPO on useampana vuonna saanut Suomen innostavimmat työpaikat -tunnustuksen. Toimintamme taloudellinen menestys päätyy kokonaisuudessaan kauppapalvelujemme kestävään kehittämiseen ja asiakasomistajiemme eduksi.

jobs.title: Project Manager (marine applications)
jobs.description:
On behalf of our customer we are now looking for a seasoned PROJECT MANAGER with documented maritime experience to strengthen the delivery team in Helsinki. As a world leader in the marine sector our customer provides innovative technologies and life-cycle solutions. The harnessing of maritime digitalisation enables better efficiency, safety and compliance. It combines bridge infrastructure, cloud data services, decision support systems, and smart port solutions to enable fleet operators shore-to-shore visibility. As a project manager you are part of the process making it all happen. You should preferably have several years of expecience in managing delivery projects from the beginning to closing. With your team at arm's length distance you handle all steps in project; planning, scheduling, monitoring, managing project resources, risks mitigation, project financials, change management, communications and reporting. While you have an understanding of the physical ship context, electrical-automation and cablings you work seamlessly with technical delivery engineers, system engineers and commissioning engineers following well-defined timeframes.

Assignment duration to start with is one year and following a successful ramp-up work can partly be done remotely. The assignment is also suitable for freelance entrepreneurs part of our supplier network.

We expect of you:

- relevant M.Sc/B.Sc engineering degree.

- fluent written and spoken English.

- fluent in MS Project

- proven track of more than 5 years of project management experience in system deliveries including physical equipments, electrical components and software. Preferably to cruise ships.

- understanding of data interfaces to other system eg. data logger, data transfer, UI, performance monitoring, KPIs

- and appreciate your knowledge of shipbuilding processes and ship operations.

- ability to work and make decision independently.

- good networking and collaboration skills with self-driven attitude and result orientation.

- ability to work both independently and as team member under the occasional time-pressure.

We offer you:

- a great opportunity and vantage point to participating in the ongoing global-scale maritime sector digitalisation for increased sustainability, efficiency and safety.

- an opportunity to leave your own mark as member of the project management process while adding a strong reference in your competence portfolio.

- an exciting role contributing to the dynamic growth of our client account and international consulting service offering.

- a competitive and encouraging salary closely mirroring your performance.

On fire? Please submit your application and CV ASAP as we are interviewing candidates as they come in! Inquiries also directly by phone.


ECHO Engineering

Echo Engineering Oy (www.echoengineering.fi) was established in 2019 to respond to the fluctuating demand for assignment-based technical professionals in the technology industry. For our parent company, Kaiku HR, this direction is a natural step towards offering a more comprehensive skill palette for the clients. To chosen clients we not only offer local technical consulting services, but also flexible remote design capacity out of India or bring technical experts to Finland for long-term assignments. Combining our capabilities, we can offer services that correspond to the high Finnish quality standards in a competitive price range. Our key personnel have over 20 years of experience in the field: Mats Lindholms expertise lies in selling services of local hour based freelance engineers, recruiting, and acting as an agent. Anil Talwani has a strong portfolio of selling, organizing, and executing remote design services between Finland and India.

Our parent company Kaiku HR (www.kaikuhr.fi) is a company specialized in recruitment and staffing, connecting the right people with the right jobs. A motivated and enthusiastic employee is key to ensuring the satisfaction of our client companies. Operations are based on a people-focused approach, mutual respect, a straightforward, no-nonsense way of working, and a strong commitment to keeping our promises. In 2025, group revenue was approximately €21.4 million. Over the years, we have successfully recruited thousands of professionals both in Finland and internationally. jobs.title: Senior Sales Specialist – Mining Trucks & Heavy Machinery (South America)
jobs.description:
1. Key responsibilities


- Develop and grow sales of heavy trucks, mining trucks, and machinery in South America.

- Identify and establish relationships with potential customers, including mining companies, truck dealers, machinery resellers, importers, and other relevant businesses.

- Leverage existing industry contacts and develop a strong customer network across target markets.

- Identify customer requirements and match them with suitable trucks, machinery, and equipment available for sale.

- Manage the complete sales process, from prospecting and quotations to negotiations, closing deals, and follow-up.

- Research market trends, customer demand, competitor activity, and opportunities in the region.

- Negotiate prices and commercial terms while maintaining profitability.

- Coordinate with internal teams regarding equipment availability, export documentation, transportation, and delivery.

- Represent the company professionally and build long-term partnerships with customers.


Required qualifications and experience

- Proven experience in sales within heavy trucks, mining equipment, construction machinery, or a closely related industry.

- Strong knowledge of the heavy vehicle and machinery market, including equipment specifications and customer requirements.

- Demonstrated ability to generate sales and develop new business opportunities.

- Good understanding of the South American market and its commercial environment.

- Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage the sales process from beginning to end.

- Willingness to travel internationally when required.


Language requirements

- **Spanish:** Essential for communicating with customers in Spanish-speaking South American markets.

- **English:** Required for internal communication and international business.

- **Portuguese:** A strong advantage, particularly for business development in Brazil.


Preferred qualifications

- An established network of contacts in the South American mining, transport, or heavy equipment sectors.

- Previous experience exporting used heavy trucks, mining equipment, or machinery internationally.

- Familiarity with international trade, export procedures, shipping, and cross-border transactions.

- Knowledge of markets such as Chile, Peru, Bolivia or Brazil.

- Experience working with international dealers, importers, distributors, or end users.


What we are looking for

We are particularly interested in candidates who combine practical industry knowledge with a strong commercial mindset.

You should be comfortable approaching new customers, understanding their equipment needs, negotiating commercial agreements, and developing business opportunities into completed transactions.

An existing customer network in South America is a significant advantage. We value practical experience, initiative, reliability, and the ability to deliver measurable sales results.

jobs.title: Hesburger-palveluvastaavaksi ABC Tikkulaan Poriin
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Hesburger-palveluvastaava ABC Tikkulaan

Haluatko päästä johtamaan yhtä ABC Tikkulan tärkeimmistä liiketoiminta-alueista ja vaikuttamaan sekä henkilöstön että asiakkaiden arkeen? Olemme hakemassa uutta Hesburger-palveluvastaavaa nykyisen palveluvastaavamme siirtyessä uusiin vastuullisempiin tehtäviin. Tule meille palveluvastaavaksi ja tekemään kanssamme ihan tavallisia töitä, joiden kautta syntyy ABC Tikkulan poikkeuksellisen hyvä ja sujuva yhteinen arki, joka välittyy aina asiakkaillemme asti!

Etsimme Hesburger-palveluvastaavaa vastaamaan Hesburgerin päivittäisestä toiminnasta, henkilöstön tukemisesta sekä liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä osana ABC Tikkulan esihenkilötiimiä.

Kyseessä on kokoaikainen vakituinen työsuhde ja vaihteleva vuorotyö 24 h avoinna olevassa yksikössä. Työn aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan.

Hesburger-palveluvastaavanatoimit arjen johtajana ja henkilöstön tukena päivittäisessä työssä. Varmistat, että Hesburgerissa tarjotaan laadukasta palvelua, tuotteet ovat kunnossa ja työyhteisö voi hyvin. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä liikennemyymäläpäällikön, keittiön palveluvastaavan, vuoropäälliköiden ja muun henkilöstön kanssa.

Tehtäväsi sisältää:
Hesburgerin päivittäisen toiminnan johtamista
Vuoropäälliköiden ja henkilöstön tukemista arjen tilanteissa
Uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämistä ja osaamisen kehittämistä
Palvelun laadun, siisteyden ja asiakaskokemuksen varmistamista
Omavalvonnan ja elintarviketurvallisuuden toteutumisen seurantaa
Myynnin, hävikin ja työtehokkuuden seuraamista
Kampanjoiden ja uusien toimintatapojen jalkauttamista
Kehitysideoiden tunnistamista ja käytäntöön viemistä yhdessä esihenkilötiimin kanssa

Odotamme sinultaaiempaa kokemusta ja näyttöä esihenkilötehtävistä sekä kokemusta ravintola-, pikaruoka- tai palveluliiketoiminnasta.Tehtävässä edellytetään kykyä johtaa ihmisiä innostavasti ja oikeudenmukaisesti. Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, ja työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti sekä ratkaisukeskeisesti. Halu kehittää toimintaa ja saada ihmiset onnistumaan on sinulle luontaista, ja pystyt toimimaan sujuvasti myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa tehden päätöksiä arjen keskellä.Aiempi Hesburger -konseptiosaaminen katsotaan eduksi,mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme motivaatiota johtaa, kehittää ja tukea muita onnistumaan.

Tarjoamme sinullemonipuolisen ja vastuullisen esihenkilötehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan oman vastuualueesi kehittämiseen. Saat tueksesi ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä mahdollisuuden työnantajan tarjoamien valmennusten ja koulutusten avulla kehittää omaa johtamisosaamistasi edelleen. Lisäksi tarjoamme näköalapaikan yhden Suomen vilkkaimman liikennemyymälän arkeen. Työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi Satakunnan Osuuskaupan ja S-ryhmän erinomaiset henkilöstöedut, joista löydät kattavan listauksentäältä!

Meillä ABC Tikkulassa tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä ja arjen onnistuminen mahdollistetaan yhdessä. Arvostamme positiivista asennetta, yhteistyötä ja halua rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa työntekijät viihtyvät. Jos monipuolinen työarki ja vastuullinen rooli tuntuu omalta, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistäänsunnuntaina1.11.2026.

Toteutamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastattelukierroksen Recright-videohaastatteluna ja haastattelukutsut lähetämme sähköpostitse hakuajan päätyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästäantaa liikennemyymäläpäällikköHenna Stenius (puh.044 7252704 / henna.stenius@sok.fi).



Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on paikallinen yritys, jonka omistavat satakuntalaiset asiakasomistajat. Tehtävämme on tuottaa asiakasomistajillemme palveluita ja etuja. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. jobs.title: Floor Layer – Resilient Flooring
jobs.description:

Key responsibilities

  • Installing resilient floor coverings, particularly linoleum and vinyl.

  • Installing vinyl flooring in wet rooms.

  • Welding flooring seams and creating upstands along walls.

  • Preparing, levelling and smoothing subfloors.

  • Reading technical drawings and work instructions.

  • Working on new-build, renovation and public-sector projects.

  • Ensuring high-quality workmanship and compliance with project requirements.

Requirements

  • Proven experience installing linoleum, vinyl and other resilient floor coverings.

  • Experience with subfloor preparation, levelling and smoothing.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and work descriptions.

Knowledge of products and systems from brands such as Ardex, Tarkett, Polyflor and Gerflor is an additional advantage.

  • The possibility of free accommodation in a single room.

  • NOK 1,500 reimbursement for the first ticket to Norway.

  • Assistance with obtaining a Norwegian D-number.

  • Commuting by bus; arrangements for travel time beyond 7.5 km are subject to the project terms.

Contact

Natalia Janeczek – Adecco
Phone: +48 726 008 495
E-mail: natalia.janeczek@adecco.no

jobs.title: Coordinator for Policy Area Ship (PA Ship within the EUSBSR)
jobs.employer: Kotka Maritime Research Association, Meriturvallisuuden ja -liikenteen tutkimusyhdistys (Merikotka) ry
jobs.description:
The EU Strategy for the Baltic Sea Region promotes cooperation to address shared challenges and achieve three objectives: Save the Sea, Connect the Region and Increase Prosperity. Its Action Plan is implemented through 14 Policy Areas, which bring together relevant stakeholders to develop and coordinate joint actions across the region.

Policy Area Ship aims to make the Baltic Sea Region a model region for clean shipping. It promotes cooperation to minimise ship-based pollution while strengthening the positive contribution of maritime transport to the region's sustainable development and prosperity.

As Policy Area Ship Coordinator, you will facilitate cooperation between stakeholders and advance the Policy Area's objectives by connecting expertise, initiatives and organisations across the Baltic Sea Region. You will help identify opportunities for joint action, strengthen stakeholder engagement and support the development and implementation of activities that promote sustainable shipping. The role combines international cooperation, stakeholder engagement, strategic coordination and the promotion of practical solutions for the maritime sector.

We are looking for a collaborative and proactive professional who understands the maritime sector and can bring diverse stakeholders together to advance shared objectives.

You have:

- A relevant Master's degree and a broad understanding of the maritime sector, including its development trends and future challenges.

- Excellent collaboration and networking skills, with the ability to engage, motivate and bring together stakeholders from different organisations and backgrounds.

- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

- Experience and a clear understanding of the skills required for coordination work, including stakeholder engagement, communication and the facilitation of joint activities.

- The ability to translate strategic objectives into practical actions and promote cooperation towards shared goals.


An established network within the maritime sector, experience in preparing or implementing EU-funded projects, and experience in international cooperation, policy development or working with public authorities and industry stakeholders will be considered an advantage.

What we offer

- An opportunity to work with a knowledgeable team and a multidisciplinary research network.

- Meaningful work contributing to the sustainable development of shipping in the Baltic Sea Region.

- Opportunities to engage with key stakeholders across countries, organisations and sectors.

- Professional development within the Kotka Maritime Research Centre's research and cooperation network.

- Flexible working arrangements.

- Comprehensive occupational health care and competitive employee benefits.


The position is funded by the Interreg Baltic Sea Region Programme and is subject to a positive funding decision.

jobs.title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist
jobs.description:
Consultant Interventional Cardiologist – PCI On-Call Service

Department of Cardiology, Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark

The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer
  • The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
  • An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
  • Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
  • An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements
  • You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
  • You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
  • You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
  • Or are willing to learn Danish
  • You can perform PCI procedures independently.
  • You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
  • You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
  • You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
  • You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
  • You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.

Desirable qualifications
  • Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
  • Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
  • Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
  • Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
  • Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.

About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:
  • 6,000 invasive procedures annually
  • 8,000 inpatient admissions annually
  • More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
  • Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually

Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk
 
Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously. The advertisement will be withdrawn once the position has been filled.
Please submit your application by email to:
Ljubica Vukelic Andersen
Head of Department of Cardiology
Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark
Email: ljubica.andersen@rn.dk
Telephone: +45 30 38 25 10

Please include:
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • Letter of motivation
  • Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
  • List of publications, if applicable.

The assessment process will follow the applicable Danish requirements for consultant appointments, including assessment of competencies across the seven physician roles.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description:
**About Kontorva**

Kontorva is a technology company based in Espoo. We build data and AI products, and we help retail, hospitality and wholesale businesses turn their sales and stock data into decisions through analytics services. We are growing our commercial team in Finland and are looking for a Business Development Associate to work directly with our CEO.

**The role**

You will be part of the engine that brings in new customers and partners. You will work across our products and service lines, with Finland as your first market. The work is 15 hours a week, Monday to Thursday, split between our Espoo office and remote work.

**What you will do**

- Find and research target companies, run outreach in Finnish and English, and book meetings

- Keep our sales pipeline up to date and report weekly on what is moving

- Co-lead Finnish-language customer meetings with the CEO, prepare proposals and follow up

- Run onboarding for new customers and trial users, and pass their feedback to our product team

- Spot, build and maintain relationships with partner organisations and institutions, such as export promotion agencies and innovation hubs


**What we are looking for**

- Native-level Finnish and fluent English

- Studying business or sales, or a recent graduate

- Comfortable on calls and in meetings, and in building relationships with institutions and senior contacts

- Clear writing in outreach and follow-up

- Independent: you manage your own work and keep it visible to the team

- Happy to work across several products


Nice to have: experience with a CRM tool, familiarity with retail, hospitality or wholesale, and an interest in data or software products.

**What we offer**

- A fixed monthly gross salary of 1,200 EUR

- A fixed-term contract of 12 months with a probation period, and a clear path to a permanent role

- Direct work with the CEO and exposure to the full sales cycle, from first contact to a signed customer

- Flexible hours that fit around studies, in a company that works a four-day week (Monday to Thursday)

jobs.title: Tukitiimin asiantuntija, 50 % – Tampere
jobs.description:
**Tee digiarjesta helpompaa sosiaalialan ammattilaisille!**

Osaatko ratkaista tietoteknisen pulman ja selittää ratkaisun niin, että toinenkin oppii? Käytätkö tekoälyä sujuvasti ja löydät sen avulla parempia tapoja tehdä työtä? Meillä osaamisellasi on konkreettinen vaikutus: autat sosiaalialan ammattilaisia keskittymään ihmisten auttamiseen.

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut tuottaa kotiin vietäviä sosiaalihuollon palveluja. Etsimme Tampereen toimistollemme osa-aikaista tukitiimin asiantuntijaa, joka yhdistää teknisen osaamisen erinomaisiin vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoihin. Olet henkilöstömme helposti lähestyttävä tuki järjestelmien ja digitaalisten työvälineiden käytössä. Neuvot, näytät käytännössä ja laadit ymmärrettäviä ohjeita. Henkilöstön digitaidot vaihtelevat, joten osaat aloittaa tarvittaessa aivan perusteista ja mukauttaa opastuksen jokaisen osaamiseen.

Työhösi kuuluu:

- Henkilöstön opastaminen sekä arjen IT-pulmien ratkaiseminen.

- Järjestelmien, käyttöoikeuksien ja lisenssien hallinta. Työvälineitä ovat muun muassa Microsoft 365, DomaCare, Hailer sekä Kanta-, Soteri- ja palvelusetelijärjestelmät.

- Asiakirjojen valmistelu ja selkeiden kokonaisuuksien kokoaminen toimitusjohtajan, palvelujohtajan ja taloushallinnon tarpeisiin.

- Verkkosivujen sekä markkinoinnin ja sosiaalisen median tekninen ylläpito.

- Kilpailutusten valmistelun ja hallinnon tukeminen sekä käytännön toimintatapojen kehittäminen.

- Työskentelet suoraan toimitusjohtajan alaisuudessa ja yhteistyössä palvelujohdon ja muun hallinnon kanssa.

Millainen osaaja sopii meille?

Tärkeintä on, että osaat tehdä tekniikasta ymmärrettävää. Olet kärsivällinen ja selkeä opastaja, jonka puoleen uskaltaa kääntyä myös ihan peruskysymyksissä. Kuuntelet, teet yhteistyötä ja viet asiat loppuun.

Edellytämme:

- Soveltuvaa suoritettua tutkintoa, esimerkiksi tieto- ja viestintätekniikan perustutkintoa tai tietojenkäsittelyn tradenomin tutkintoa. Loppuvaiheen opiskelijat huomioidaan.

- Hyvää käytännön IT-osaamista ja kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä.

- Sujuvaa ja tehokasta tekoälyn käyttöä työvälineenä esimerkiksi asiakirjojen ja ohjeiden laatimisessa, tiedonhaussa ja ongelmanratkaisussa. Tarkistat tuotosten oikeellisuuden ja huomioit tietosuojan.

- Selkeää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä kykyä jäsentää tietoa ymmärrettäviksi kokonaisuuksiksi.

- Kokemus käyttäjien opastamisesta, Microsoft 365 -ympäristöstä tai sosiaali- ja terveysalalta on eduksi. Kaikkia käyttämiämme järjestelmiä ei tarvitse tuntea ennestään.


Miksi meille?

- Saat monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa työsi tulokset näkyvät suoraan muiden arjessa.

- Pääset kehittämään käytännön ratkaisuja, hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja vaikuttamaan siihen, miten digitaalisia työvälineitä käytetään yrityksessämme.

- Sosiaalialan kollegasi tuovat yhteistyöhön oman osaamisensa – sinä autat heitä saamaan enemmän irti teknologiasta.

- Voit vaikuttaa työaikoihisi. Työ tapahtuu arkisin kello 8:00-18:00 välillä.

- Työ tehdään Tampereen toimistollamme. Toivomme että viihdyt yhteisessä toimistossa ja tulet hyvin toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa. Autat muita mielelläsi, mutta osaat myös keskittyä omiin tehtäviisi ja jatkaa niitä keskeytysten jälkeen. Huomioit työtoverisi ja annat heille työrauhan.

- Työaika on **50 % kokoaikaisesta työajasta**. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaluokka on **G24D**, ja palkka 50 %:n työajalla on **1 405,55–1 535,55 €/kk** hyväksyttävästä palvelusajasta riippuen.

Työn aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

jobs.title: Er du typen, der tager ansvar og får tingene til at spille? Så læs med her!
jobs.description:
Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst og praktisk anlagt medarbejder til en fuldtidsstilling på daghold hos en mindre produktionsvirksomhed i Herning.

Virksomheden producerer blandt andet bordplader og trapper, og her er stolte håndværkstraditioner og høj kvalitet en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan lide at tage fat, holde overblik og gå forrest, når der er brug for det. Du behøver ikke at være leder, men du skal have lyst til at tage ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrage til, at hverdagen fungerer godt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Pakning og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Forsendelse og håndtering af tilhørende papirer

  • Truckkørsel

  • Betjening af pudsemaskine

  • Læsning af tegninger, ordrer og arbejdsinstruktioner

Der kan også være andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen, så det er vigtigt, at du trives med en varieret arbejdsdag og er klar til at hjælpe dér, hvor der er behov.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er en voksen og moden person, som har en naturlig ansvarsfølelse og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du tager gerne initiativ, følger dine opgaver til dørs og har øje for både kvalitet og orden.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra træindustrien og/eller med lager og logistik

  • Har truckcertifikat og erfaring med truckkørsel

  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Er stabil, kvalitetsbevidst og god til at samarbejde

  • Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk – det er et krav, da du skal kunne læse tegninger, ordrer, forsendelsespapirer og vigtige arbejdsinstruktioner på dansk

Hvad kan du forvente?

Du bliver en del af en mindre virksomhed med omkring 15 engagerede kolleger, som står klar til at tage godt imod dig og lære dig op i opgaverne.

Her er der kort vej fra tanke til handling, og du får mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift. Det er en arbejdsplads, hvor man hjælper hinanden, tager ansvar og arbejder sammen om at levere et godt resultat.

Du bliver i første omgang ansat gennem Medarbejderne ApS i en prøveperiode. For den rette medarbejder er der gode muligheder for fastansættelse hos virksomheden på sigt.

Lyder det som en stilling for dig?

Så ansøg om stillingen via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020175

Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mails bliver IKKE behandlet.

Arbejdssted: Herning
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid på daghold

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Vi er et veldrevet Vikar & Rekrutterings Bureau, med mange års erfaring og en høj standard. Vi er medlem af VikarBranchen DI, som bla. andet forpligtiger os til at overholde mange etiske regler så som GDPR og overenskomster. Vi lever af at knytte kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager.

En god morgen starter med en varm velkomst, frisk kaffe og en indbydende morgenbuffet. Derfor søger vi engagerede kollegaer, som har lyst til at gøre morgenmaden til en god oplevelse for vores gæster.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

  • Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

  • Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

  • You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

  • You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

  • You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.
