jobs.title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
jobs.description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and weâre only just getting started.

Weâre a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If youâre driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

ð The Role

Title: Product Design Director

Team: Design

Location: Remote, UK

Experience quality is one of the clearest ways Midnite differentiates in a category that too often settles for functional and familiar. As a Product Design Director, you will ensure craft, quality and ambition remain central to how we build, as we scale. You will lead Product Design, shape company wide experience direction, and embed Design in the most important product decisions. This is a role with real influence, accountable for how Midnite feels across every surface and responsible for raising the bar as we grow.

You will:

  • Lead and develop our Product Design team, line managing five designers and setting a clear standard for craft, judgement and ownership.

  • Define and uphold the experience bar across all product surfaces, from customer facing native and web to back office platforms.

  • Ensure coherence across squads and journeys so Midnite feels like one joined up system rather than a collection of features.

  • Shape the long term experience direction and codify principles that guide teams toward a shared north star.

  • Mature and drive adoption of our design systems to enable both speed and consistency at scale.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership on strategy, early problem framing and complex trade offs.

  • Contribute hands on to Midniteâs most complex and high impact initiatives, elevating outcomes through strong visual and interaction design.

  • Collaborate with Brand, Creative, Growth, CRM and Games to ensure the end to end customer experience is cohesive and well crafted.

  • Explore and integrate emerging technologies, including AI, where they meaningfully improve how we design and build.

  • Strengthen the structures and standards that allow experience quality to scale as the company grows

The next Midniter:

  • Sets and defends a high bar for visual and interaction design, with exceptional taste and strong product instincts.

  • Has operated at scale, shaping design direction across multiple teams and surfaces.

  • Has built or matured design systems that improve consistency and enable teams to move faster without sacrificing quality.

  • Brings hands on craft capability and is comfortable directly contributing to high stakes initiatives.

  • Is a trusted strategic partner to Product and Engineering leaders, contributing meaningfully to roadmap direction and key decisions.

  • Develops designers through thoughtful feedback, coaching and hiring, steadily raising overall team capability.

  • Communicates clearly and practically, influencing across disciplines and levels of seniority.

  • Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and thoughtful about where they add real value.

  • Cares deeply about building well designed digital products, from simplifying complex systems to refining interaction, motion and hierarchy.

ð° Winnings

  • Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

  • Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

  • Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

  • Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.

  • Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

  • Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

At Midnite, we are committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

About the Role

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live.

You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions.

For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform.

Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA.

 

 

Responsibilities

Proactively monitor merchant technical health

  • Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies.

  • Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues.

  • Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected.

  • Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants.

Be the main technical contact after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live.

  • Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior.

  • Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support.

Support technical incident management

  • Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues.

  • Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams.

  • Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up.

  • Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely.

  • Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required.

Drive merchant technical improvements

  • Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost.

  • Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth.

  • Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch.

Build merchant health visibility

  • Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants.

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks.

  • Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally.

 

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles.

  • Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS.

  • Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support.

  • Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English.

  • Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must.

  • Startup environment experience is a plus.

 

 

What Success Looks Like

A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks.

The TAM should help ensure that:

  • Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly.

  • Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership.

  • Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication.

  • Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts.

  • Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA.

jobs.title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (Ohio residency required)

Classification: Full-time, exempt
Reports to: School Leader

Pay Range: $40.00 - $48.00 per hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Instructional Staff Management

  • Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

  • Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

  • Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

  • Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

  • Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

  • Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

  • Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

  • Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

  • Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

  • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

  • Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

  • Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

  • Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

  • Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

  • Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

  • Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

Professional Development

  • Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.

  • Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.

  • Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

  • Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

  • Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

  • Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers

  • Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

  • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

  • A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability

  • Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

  • Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

  • Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026.



Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred

  • Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements

  • At least 3 years of teaching experience

  • At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal

  • Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online

  • Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews

  • Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems

The Ideal Candidate Brings:

  • Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data

  • Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school

Compensation & Benefits

  • The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800.

And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

·        Peger opad og inspirerer til at søge Gud

·        Styrker og engagerer den enkelte og menigheden

 

    - for at gøre evangeliet kendt, troet og levet.

 

Konkret betyder det, at…

·        du – i samarbejde med bl.a. menighedsrådet, projektets styregruppe og den anden projektmedarbejder – sikrer den daglige drift på STEDET, og i mange sammenhænge er du STEDETs ansigt udadtil.

·        du er vært på STEDET, så de unge der kommer ind ad døren, mærker at de er velkomne her.

·        du ærligt kan sige, at du har lyst til at arbejde sammen med unge, er imødekommende og kan tage initiativ til fx en snak eller igangsætte brætspil.

·        du indgår i et samarbejde med ansatte og frivillige om at planlægge og afvikle forskellige typer af aktiviteter. Fx fællesspisning hvor du veksler mellem at stå i front og ”være den” og stå i baggrunden og få andre til at lykkes i deres frivillige opgave.

·        du sidder med i styregruppen (som består af repræsentanter for menighedsråd, ungdomsråd og ansatte ved Christianskirken) for STEDET, og er med til at sætte retning for projektet, og i mange tilfælde er du ansvarlig for at det som besluttes dér, bliver til virkelighed.

·        du vil være ansvarlig for rekruttering, fastholdelse og udrustning af frivillige. For STEDET er ikke noget, som laves for de unge, men noget vi laver sammen med unge.

·        du får til opgave at pleje og videreudvikle vores netværk med samarbejdspartnere og interessenter i Aarhus. Det er fx uddannelsesinstitutioner, NGO’er som arbejder med unge, naboer på Katrinebjerg, nøglepersoner i Aarhus kommune og kirker i Aarhus.

·        du løser forskellige administrative og koordinerende opgaver såsom at have overblik over vores forbrug og sørge for at betalinger sker rettidigt; booking af lokaler; forberedelse af møder, at vores tillidsbod har varer på hylderne m.v.

 

I det daglige er din nærmeste kollega vores projektmedarbejder, som har fokus på kommunikation og aktiviteter og den præst, som er tilknyttet STEDET og er projektleder. I har hver jeres ansvarsområder, men arbejder sammen om meget af det som sker på STEDET.

 

Vi forventer at du…

·        har en konstruktiv tilgang til tingene og kan samarbejde med både professionelle og amatører.

·        har erfaring fra selv at have frivilligt engageret, og gerne at du har erfaring med engagere, motivere og samarbejde andre frivillige på en måde, så de føler sig påskønnede og som en aktiv del af STEDETS liv og aktiviteter.

·       er nysgerrig på nye mennesker og har det godt med at samle mennesker.

·        kan se idéen i at vi som kirke laver dette tilbud til unge i vores by.

·        er i stand til at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete handlinger.

·        har syn for både helheden og detaljen, og trives med at arbejde både på et overordnet og et praktisk plan. Nogle dage vil du derfor sidde og udvikle en idé, og andre dage svinger du støvsugeren, så der er klar til næste event.

·        kan lide at arbejde i team med andre, samtidig med at du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret med dine opgaver.

·        har en faglig eller erfaringsmæssig baggrund, som er relevant for dette job.

·        er fleksibel ift arbejdstid. Der er primært tale om arbejde i dagtimerne, men der er også aftenarbejde i skiftende omfang.

·        kan identificere dig med Christianskirkens samspilsværdier - åbenhed, respekt, omsorg og engagement - samt evner at omsætte disse i relation til andre mennesker.

 

 

Om kirken:

Christianskirken er en aktiv kirke på Christiansbjerg. Kirkens arbejde præges af mere end 400 frivillige, der bidrager til kirkens liv og aktiviteter på forskellig vis.

Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

•        Samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i et godt arbejdsmiljø, der vægter teamsamarbejdet højt.

•        Godt besøgte gudstjenester, der i udtryk og stilarter rummer variation, tradition og fornyelse.  

•        Et rigt menighedsliv.

 

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder, Vibeke Dahmen på 41 72 71 06 eller projektleder Lasse Holmgaard Iversen på 26 25 57 88.

Som ansat ved Christianskirken refererer du overordnet set til menighedsrådet som arbejdsgiver, repræsenteret ved menighedsrådets kontaktperson. I det daglige referer du til Christianskirkens daglige leder, Vibeke Dahmen, der vil forestå den daglige ledelsesopgave, samt til projektleder for STEDET, sognepræst Lasse Holmgaard Iversen. Beskrivelse af sognet kan findes på kirkens hjemmeside www.christianskirken.dk

Ansøgningssted: Ansøgning, anbefalinger, referencer samt kopi af evt. eksamensbevis, sendes via sikker mail til kirkekontoret, att. daglig leder Vibeke Dahmen. (Link findes på kirkens hjemmeside).

Ansøgningsfrist: 1. november 2026.

Samtaler: Forventes afholdt d. 11. og/eller 12. november 2026, i tidsrummet mellem kl. 16 og 21.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles i overensstemmelse med gældende overenskomster på området. Disse kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk.

Løn samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

jobs.title: Global Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Notion’s founding Demo Engineers, you’ll build the global demo engine behind how we bring Notion’s most important customer stories to life. You’ll shape the standards, systems, and experiences that help our Sales teams demonstrate what is possible with Notion, from the first customer conversation through implementation and deployment.



This is a high-impact opportunity to create the function from the ground up. You’ll establish global standards, turn our strongest customer solutions into repeatable demos, and give regional teams the tools and autonomy to innovate. Your work will directly influence how customers understand Notion’s platform, AI capabilities, and potential to transform how their organizations work.



This role reports to the Global Head of Acquisition and partners closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Enablement, and PMM.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build the global demo engine that brings Notion’s most important customer stories to life
   
   - Partner with Enablement and PMM to define the core narratives, scripts, environments, and assets for each demo
   
   - Create a durable release and versioning process so demos stay current as the product evolves
   
   - Automate repeatable setup and maintenance wherever possible so the system can scale globally

 - Turn Notion’s strongest customer and internal solutions into reusable GTM assets
   
   - Identify high-impact use cases and transform them into repeatable, field-ready demos
   
   - Partner with FDE to package customer solutions, implementation guidance, and technical patterns into demos the field can confidently deliver
   
   - Work with GTM Systems to translate demos into workspaces that can be deployed in customer environments

 - Set the global standard for demo quality and help the field deliver it
   
   - Define what great looks like for each demo moment, from the first customer conversation to a tailored technical experience
   
   - Train and coach customer-facing teams on storytelling, environment setup, delivery, and troubleshooting
   
   - Partner with Enablement to create practical resources and programs that raise demo quality across regions

 - Create a clear path from experimentation to global scale
   
   - Give customer-facing teams a structured way to safely build, test, and pilot new demo concepts
   
   - Evaluate the strongest ideas and turn them into scalable standards, templates, and reusable assets

 - Serve as the strategic demo partner for high-impact opportunities
   
   - Advise teams on custom or personalized demos that fall outside the standard portfolio
   
   - Help teams balance customer relevance, technical credibility, and speed without compromising quality




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years in a technical or customer-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Demo Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Engineering

 - Experience designing and delivering technical demos, prototypes, or solution experiences for a SaaS product

 - Strong systems thinking, with experience building scalable standards, templates, documentation, versioning practices, and operating processes

 - Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer stories tied to business value

 - Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, automation, data, permissions, and enterprise security concepts

 - Working proficiency with scripting or automation tools such as Python or JavaScript

 - Experience partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Marketing to drive alignment and deliver shared outcomes

 - Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to raise the capabilities of customer-facing teams

 - Comfort creating structure, setting priorities, and making progress in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building or scaling a demo engineering, solutions engineering, or technical enablement function

 - Experience with enterprise sales cycles and complex, multi-stakeholder customer environments

 - Hands-on experience with demo automation platforms such as Consensus, Navattic, Reprise, Storylane, or Demostack

 - Experience supporting major product launches or global go-to-market programs

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

 - Experience with productivity, collaboration, AI, or horizontal SaaS products

 - Notion power user
   


TOOLS YOU'LL USE:

 - Demo environments: Notion, plus demo automation platforms as needed

 - Collaboration: Slack, Salesforce, Gong for call review

 - Automation: Zapier, scripting tools, API clients (Postman or similar)

 - AI Coding Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $220,000 - $250,000 per year.


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Holstedgaard søger en sygeplejerske gerne med psykiatrisk erfaring
jobs.description:
Vil du gøre en mærkbar forskel i krydsfeltet mellem psykiatri og somatik?

Brænder du for den komplekse psykiatriske sygepleje, og drives du af at opbygge stærke, tillidsfulde relationer til beboerne? Så har vi den helt rette stilling til dig på Holstedgaard i Næstved.

Hvem er vi?

Holstedgaard er et socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor 69 beboere fordelt på flere teams og med forskellige psykiatriske diagnoser. Som en særlig og spændende faglig udfordring har mange af vores beboere også komplicerede somatiske lidelser.

Dine vigtigste opgaver hos os vil være:

  • Helhedsorienteret sygepleje: Ansvar for den grundlæggende og komplekse sygepleje hos beboerne med et skarpt blik for både de psykiske og somatiske problemstillinger.

  • Faglig dokumentation: Sikre høj kvalitet i den sundhedsfaglige og socialpædagogiske dokumentation.

  • Metodisk arbejde: Indgå i teamsamarbejdet med afsæt i Holstedgaards socialpædagogiske metoder.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde: At være en del af et tværfagligt team med blandt andet pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter samt en skolelærer.

Dine kompetencer:

  • Du er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske – gerne med erfaring inden for psykiatri eller en specialuddannelse i psykiatrisk sygepleje.

  • Du drives af at arbejde med mennesker med sammensatte behov og af at støtte dem i forhold til både personlig pleje og psykisk omsorg.

  • Du har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt og ser fælles succes som målet.

  • Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til principperne i Low Arousal, Recovery og KRAP-modellen – men det er ikke et krav, da vi sørger for, at du bliver klædt godt på hos os.

jobs.title: Pædagog søges til Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye Kollega

Brænder du for at skabe meningsfulde relationer og understøtte mennesker i at leve det liv, de ønsker? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores engagerede medarbejdergruppe på Holstedgaard.

På Holstedgaard udvider vi vores personalegruppe og søger en pædagog, der gennem tillidsfulde relationer kan motivere, inddrage og samarbejde med vores beboere. Vi arbejder målrettet for, at beboerne oplever medbestemmelse, tryghed og et hjemligt miljø, hvor deres ønsker, behov og drømme er i centrum.

Vores botilbud er først og fremmest beboernes hjem. Da flere af vores beboere udover psykiske lidelser også har somatiske problemstillinger, yder vi en helhedsorienteret indsats. Som pædagog hos os skal du derfor forvente, at der også er perioder, hvor du skal deltage i og være ansvarlig for, at der udføres personlig pleje som en naturlig del af beboerens hverdag og trivsel.

Om Holstedgaard

Holstedgaard har 69 pladser fordelt på flere teams. Vi tilbyder både midlertidige og længerevarende ophold efter Servicelovens §§ 107 og 108 til borgere over 18 år. Målgruppen er mennesker med forskellige psykiatriske lidelser og ofte komplekse somatiske problemstillinger.

Vi er i gang med at implementere og forankre KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik), som danner rammen om vores faglige tilgang. Her arbejder vi med fokus på beboernes styrker, ressourcer og udviklingsmuligheder.

Stillingen indebærer dag- og aftenvagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er uddannet pædagog eller har anden relevant socialpædagogisk uddannelse.

  • Er indstillet på at tage ansvar for og deltage i den personlige pleje og somatiske understøttelse af beboerne.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for det socialpædagogiske område, gerne inden for psykiatrien.

  • Arbejder fagligt reflekteret og kan omsætte teori og metode til praksis.

  • Kan dokumentere faglige indsatser og følge op på mål og delmål.

  • Er ansvarlig, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en varieret hverdag.

  • Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og samarbejde i mindre teams.

  • Værdsætter kollegial sparring, feedback og fælles refleksion.

  • Er initiativrig og ønsker at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af vores botilbud.

  • Har mod på at indgå i et læringsmiljø, hvor nysgerrighed, faglig udvikling og refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

  • Kørekort er ikke et krav, men vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En engageret og fagligt stærk medarbejdergruppe med fokus på både socialpædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsatser.

  • En mangfoldig gruppe beboere, som bidrager til en spændende og meningsfuld hverdag.

  • En uformel og anerkendende arbejdskultur med plads til humor og fællesskab.

  • Indflydelse og medansvar i et teamsamarbejde under fortsat udvikling,med fokus på trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • Løbende supervision.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Timetal: Stillingen er på 25-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

  • Ansættelsesproces: Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat høre du ikke fra os er stillingen gået til anden side.

  • Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om indhentelse af straffeattest. Ansættelse kan først finde sted, når tilfredsstillende straffeattest foreligger.

  • GDPR: Vi behandler og opbevarer alle personoplysninger i overensstemmelse med gældende GDPR-regler.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Ann-Sofie Hartvig på telefon 22757735.

Ansøgning og CV sendes til: ash@holstedgaard.dk

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Data & Analytics (BluePool and Data Governance)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our Data & Analytics department. This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants practical experience working with data platforms, governance processes, documentation, and operational support activities in an international and highly technical environment. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department. 

What You Will Be Working On 

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities. 

Examples of tasks may include: 

BluePool Support 

  • Assisting with user onboarding and access administration 

  • Maintaining onboarding guides and user documentation 

  • Supporting training sessions and workshops 

  • Gathering and tracking user feedback 

  • Assisting with testing of new BluePool functionality 

Data Governance 

  • Supporting data governance processes and documentation 

  • Maintaining data catalogues and metadata documentation 

  • Assisting with data classification and governance activities 

  • Supporting compliance and process-related initiatives 

General Department Support 

  • Coordinating meetings and workshops 

  • Maintaining team documentation and knowledge bases 

  • Preparing presentations and communication materials 

  • Supporting project coordination and follow-up activities 

  • Assisting with ad hoc analytical and administrative tasks 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within data science, computer science, engineering, information management, business analytics, economics, mathematics, or a similar field. 

You do not need extensive professional experience. What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of practical tasks — from organizing documentation and following up on details to supporting colleagues with day-to-day needs. 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is detail-oriented and follows tasks through carefully 

  • Enjoys turning information into clear documentation, guides, or overviews that others can use 

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally 

  • Can work independently while also asking for input when needed 

  • Has an interest in data, analytics, and digital platforms 

  • Is comfortable using Microsoft Office tools 

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have experience with one or more relevant tools or concepts, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, enterprise architecture, data governance, or technical documentation. 

What We Offer: 

  • A flexible student position that can be adapted to your studies 

  • Exposure to large-scale data and analytics initiatives within the energy sector 

  • Experience working in an international environment with Nordic stakeholders 

  • Insight into data governance, analytics platforms, and digital transformation 

  • Opportunities to build practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career in data and analytics 

  • A friendly and collaborative team with experienced data scientists, data engineers, and analytics specialists 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.  Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you! 
 
Your position
 
In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Your tasks & responsibilities 

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
  • Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
  • Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
  • Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
  • Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
  • Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.


Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
  • A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
  • The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

jobs.title: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference! 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

  • Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

  • Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

  • Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

  • Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

  • Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

  • Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

  • Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

  • Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

  • Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Produktionskoordinator & Creative Specialist – barselsvikariat / Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

  • Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

  • Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

  • Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

  • Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

  • Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

  • Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

  • Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

  • Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

  • Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

  • Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

  • Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

ENGLISH:

Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)

Do you imagine a position where you play a key role in an engaged and committed team creating professional film projects?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and still deliver great results? 

Are you able to facilitate film production and at the same time create a supreme client experience, both in the studio and on location?

As producer at AVdesign you will get the chance to work in a top professional, positive and encouraging work environment with like-minded individuals who have a strong passion within their field. We value rich opportunities for professional and personal development. 

 

About us

We are a Billund based international production company. AVdesign was founded in 2005 and now employs 16 colleagues including animators, CG generalists, producers, production assistants, sound designers, videographers etc.

We create a great variety of content across different platforms and support clients worldwide with a range of exciting projects.

AVdesign is located together with My Instore Radio and in total we employ 26 skilled colleagues of different nationalities.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our video team, where we have gathered some of the most skilled and dedicated enthusiasts from the business. The team consists of 6 people.

 

About the role

This is a maternity cover position, offering a unique opportunity to join AVdesign and play a key role in coordinating and delivering a wide range of media productions.

We are looking for an experienced Producer / Production Manager with a strong background in production planning and project coordination.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and adaptable, with an open mindset and a flexible approach to a broad range of assignments. Our projects vary across video production, live streaming, studio product shoots, and other media-related productions, so versatility and a willingness to take on different challenges are important.

At AVdesign, we foster an open, supportive, and collaborative working environment where sharing knowledge, ideas, and experience is highly valued.

Experience within the media industry, such as video production, live streaming, or broadcast, is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

This is a hands-on role that combines operational coordination with practical involvement in productions. It requires a genuine interest in planning, problem-solving, and collaborating with colleagues, clients, and partners to ensure successful project delivery.

 

About you

You are a natural coordinator who enjoys bringing people, plans, and ideas together. You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks at once. Whether coordinating logistics, supporting creative productions, or solving last-minute challenges, you take ownership and help keep projects on track. Fluency in Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your profile:

·      Experience in a coordination, project support, administrative, or production-related role.

·      Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

·      Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats, contributing wherever needed to support the team and deliver great productions.

·      Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

·      Experience with light photo editing, video editing, or basic graphic design is an advantage.

·      A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a flexible approach to changing priorities.

·      Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

·      A positive team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others succeed.

 

Additional information

If you are interested in the position, we would like to hear from you soon. Potentially we are looking for someone to start as soon as possible.

The role is based in Billund, Denmark. Remote working is not an option. 

If you have any question about the job, please get in touch on: application@avdesign.dk

We look forward to receiving your motivated application and CV on: application@avdesign.dk

We will interview potential candidates on an ongoing basis and deactivate the job advert once the position has been filled.

The Child and Family Agency was established on 1st January 2014 and is responsible for a range of statutory functions including provision of child protection, alternative care, specified regulatory services and a range of family support services. Further information is available on www.tusla.ie The policy of the Child and Family Agency to enable children to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. Entry requirements: Be registered in the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained by CORU. or Hold a CORU approved Social Care Worker qualification and have applied for CORU registration (evidence of application will be necessary) or Hold one of the following qualifications and be committed to a pathway towards Social Care education: Youth and Community work qualification BA (Hons) Youth and Community Development BA (Hons) Psychology Addiction Studies (Level 7) BA (Hons) Counselling and Addiction Studies Disability Diploma (Primary Care) Degree in Social Science (minimum Level 7) or equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction Purpose of role: This programme involves 3 months classroom-based learning followed by 3 months’ work placement in Tusla Special Care Unit in Dublin. The purpose of the post is to provide the employee with on the job learning opportunities as a work-based learner in social care with access to shadow a social care worker, learn social care skills while providing direct administration support to the social care services that seeks to improve the health and social wellbeing of the service users within the context of local communities and children’s residential and special care services. On successful completion of the 6-month programme and evidence of competency assessment, you will be offered a permanent contract of employment Main duties and responsibilities: To participate in the development and implementation of Care and Placement Plans and to ensure appropriate recording of same. To promote the rights and responsibilities of each child/young person within the centre. To promote physical, emotional, social and religious welfare of each young person in care. To encourage attendance at school, training centres, medical and clinical appointments.
